jobs.title: Tax Technology & Engineering
jobs.description:
Programme
Full Time Graduate
Career Path
Technology
Location
London
Start Date
September\-2027
### **Programme Description**


**What does this team do?**


Our Tax Consulting practice provides companies and high net worth individuals with advice on their tax, ensuring they remain compliant with regulations. From advising clients on investment tax to working with their innovation and property teams to ensure that the available tax reliefs are maximised, we help our clients make the right business decisions, on a worldwide scale.


A Tax Technology \& Engineering role, could mean the opportunity to work within one of the following teams:


**Digital Innovation – Digital Tax Solutions:** We are a pioneering team, committed to building cutting\-edge digital tax products and solutions. Leveraging an AI\-first approach to development, we discover, design, and deliver market\-leading innovation. We continuously experiment with new technologies to transform our business and drive revenue growth.


**Global Investments \& Innovation Incentives (Gi3\)**: The UK government offers generous tax incentives to companies operating across all areas of science, engineering and tech, to encourage investment in research and development. The Gi3 team is part of a global network of tech, engineering, science and financial specialists who work closely with companies of varying size (from start\-ups to large multinationals), helping them unlock these incentives for their innovations in chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas, manufacturing etc. This involves working closely with our clients to identify their eligible projects (and attributable expenditure), maximising the valuable incentives available.


Our team comprises specialists from both tax/financial and tech backgrounds, where engineers, scientists and IT/software technologists play a pivotal role in supporting our clients in unlocking the incentives available to them. We partner with clients working on some of the most exciting and innovative projects across all areas of science and technology.


**What skills and academic qualifications do I need?**


**Digital Innovation – Digital Tax Solutions**


We require you to demonstrate an interest in, or a degree related to, developing products, Computer Science or Software Engineering.


Related degree disciplines include:


* Computer games and animation.
* Information Systems.
* Computing.
* Engineering and technology.
* Cyber Security.

**Global Investment \& Innovation Incentives – Software Engineering:**


We require you to hold, or be working towards, a degree within a Computer Science, Software


Development/Software Engineering or related discipline.


Related degree disciplines include:


* Data Science.
* Mathematics.
* Electrical Engineering.
* Cyber Security.

**Global Investment \& Innovation Incentives – Engineering** (STEM)


We require you to have achieved, or be working towards, a degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics related degree discipline.


You’ll need to have obtained or be studying towards a minimum 2:1 degree as mentioned above and have graduated by September 2027 for the Autumn 2027 intake.


We have identified 10 core skills that are essential to all our roles in Early Careers. To learn more about these skills and their detailed descriptions, please visit the 'Discover What We Look For' section in our Candidate Zone.


**What kind of work will I do?**


By joining a student programme within Tax Technology \& Engineering, you will work with and learn from some of the most talented and experienced professionals in the industry.


You’ll have the opportunity to work with a range of clients, from FTSE 100 organisations to start\-ups and private individuals.


You’ll help them solve some of the most complex issues their business is ever likely to face. Many of our established clients are high profile, household names. You will play a key role in a multi\-disciplinary collaborative team and will learn about the UK's latest tech developments.


Depending on the area you join, you may be using your technical background to understand and support a client’s development activities or form the basis for their research and development, patent box claims and grant applications. Alternatively, by using cloud services and cutting\-edge technology (then applying it to the tax technology domain) you will support the build of software platforms to provide better business insight and efficiencies.


**Where will I work?**


At Deloitte we recognise how important face\-to\-face interaction is for your development in a new role. We also understand that our people need flexibility, which is why we operate a hybrid system, with a combination of office and home working. If you’re in a client\-facing role, you might be expected to attend client sites on certain days, while your meetings will be a mix of online and in\-person events. Please note your final assessment and induction will also be in\-person, to give you the opportunity to network and build relationships.


**All our workspaces are accessible, however, if you require further flexibility due to a health condition or caring responsibilities, please discuss this with our team. You can find further information on our** **parent and carer policies here.**


**How will I develop?**


We want our people to have worldclass practical experience coupled with the technical rigour and knowledge that comes from the right professional qualification.


We think the best experience is being immersed in client work, working alongside other team members, and learning the practical skills that will set you up for a successful career. That will be the initial focus whether you are a Graduate, an Industrial Placement, or a BrightStart, supported by internal training and support from coaches, people leaders, and your team.


We think this is vital and will set you up for success when we further support your development with a professional qualification, recognising that different roles across our business align to different pathways. These may include options such as joint or accelerated programmes leading to qualifications like Association of Taxation Technicians (ATT), Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA), Institute of Chartered Accountants of Scotland (ICAS) or Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), as well as other more specialist routes focused on tax or technical expertise.


**Additional support and benefits information**


* We’re a collaborative, inclusive firm and we want to help you to use your unique talents and perspectives in the workplace. From diversity networks to wellbeing and much more, we aim to support and reward you in the best way possible. Please use the links below to discover more about our processes, benefits, values and culture.
* You can learn more about the full recruitment process here.
* Do you have accessibility requirements or need reasonable adjustments for the interview or assessment process? Find out how we can help.
* Learn more about our values, culture and purpose as a firm.
* Want to hear from some of our people to inspire your future career? Check out our Life at Deloitte page.
* At Deloitte we value diversity, and we’re committed to ensuring that our people thrive through a wide range of initiatives and diversity networks. Discover more about inclusion and wellbeing.
* We value our people and recognise their hard work. Learn about the rewards and benefits available at Deloitte.

**Application deadlines**


**Application deadlines:** There is no specific deadline for this role, but we recommend getting your application in as soon as possible. Please note, some of our roles may close quickly if we experience high demand.


**Assessment deadlines:** Once you’ve applied to this role, you’ll receive an email from our recruitment team outlining next steps and the relevant deadlines for you to complete the following stages of our process.


We operate a strict one application per year policy across our Early Careers opportunities. We recommend only submitting an application for a role that you feel is right for you.


**Visa Sponsorship**


We accept applications from candidates who are currently on student visas for this role. We cannot accept applications from candidates who have previously spent time on a Skilled Worker or Graduate visa. If successful to offer, you must stay on your student visa until our immigration team contacts you c.3 months before your start date. See our Work Permits page for more information.


**What matters to you? Make it happen at Deloitte.**

jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description:
**United Kingdom, Aberdeen**
----------------------------

Apply Now **Job Title**
**Field Engineer Trainee (****Completions \& Well Intervention)**  

**About Us**
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act\- how to simultaneously reduce emissions and meet the world’s growing energy demands. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry, while innovating a new energy landscape. It’s what drives us. Ensuring progress for people and the planet, on the journey to net zero and beyond.  

More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!  

Aberdeen  

**Job Summary**
Field Engineer Trainees play a crucial role in our company’s growth by developing into future technical specialists, managers and leaders. This position provides the opportunity to build expertise in product knowledge, leadership, customer interaction and the delivery of engineering services accurately, safely and efficiently. As a Field Engineer Trainee, you will have opportunities to work towards professional membership with a relevant engineering institution. You will learn the business from the ground up, gaining the knowledge, skills and experience needed to become a skilled and confident specialist in your field.  

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing area of the business, supporting **Completions \& Well Intervention (CWI)** activities. You will join a small, collaborative team and undertake a structured training programme designed to develop your technical knowledge, field experience, customer\-facing skills and engineering capabilities. As you progress through your development and achieve the required technical competencies, you will have the opportunity to progress into a specialised CWI Engineering role, providing engineering and operational support for completion and well intervention activities.  

**Essential Responsibilities and Duties**
During the training program, your responsibilities will include:
* Ensure job deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.
* Supporting the planning and execution of completion, workover and well intervention operations.
* Supporting the preparation and review of Authorisations for Expenditure (AFEs)
* Develop an understanding of well integrity, well barriers, pressure control and applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
* Execute service delivery to the customer.
* Participate in job risk analysis and continual improvement programs.
* Develop customer contacts to promote company products and services.
* Ensure company and regulatory standard compliance by implementing the Compliance Assessment Tool (CAT), self\-assessments, and well site inspections.
* Participate in HSE and Quality initiatives.
* Wear PPE and observe HSE policies.
* Maintain the required safety training.
  

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Engineering. Candidates with degrees in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Petroleum, Process Engineering are particularly encouraged to apply.
* Be globally mobile.
* Willingness and ability to work in a field\-based and operational environment.
* The desire to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic business on high\-value, technically complex products/projects.
* The right to work in the United Kingdom.
  

**Preferred Skills**
* Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly and confidently.
* Be able to choose and initiate action.
* Be passionate about learning and research.
* Be eager to deliver results and meet demands.
* Remain positive during pressures, setbacks, and fast\-paced environments.
  

If this role is of interest to you and you are eager to learn more then we strongly encourage you to apply. We can then discuss how you will help shape and grow SLB moving forward  

**Why, as a graduate, should you join us**
* **Dynamic work environments**

The strength of our culture means you’ll work in a fast\-paced, supportive work environment. We offer hybrid working with a combination of on\-site \& home working days to achieve the right work\-life balance and allotted time for participating in volunteering and sustainability efforts.
* **Developing future leaders**

Become part of a community where your potential to lead is nurtured from the start. Joining us opens doors to leadership opportunities within our organization and across the broader industry, as evidenced by over 90% of our executive team who began their careers with us.
* **Borderless careers**

Our career\-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.
* **Women in STEM**

Diversity is a key part of our success, and we have focused on gender balance for nearly 25 years. We are dedicated to nurturing and developing female talent both locally and globally. To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company\-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.
* **Industry\-Leading Equipment**

Engage with cutting\-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.  

**Benefits:**
* Competitive salary.
* We offer private healthcare for employees and their families as well as subsidised dental care.
* We provide well\-being programs such as Employee Mental health support and health and wellness coaching.
* Generous private employee\-funded pension contributions.
* Income protection scheme and life insurance.
* Cycle to work scheme.
* We have multiple internal employee resources groups, female mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company\-wide webinars, amongst other opportunities.

Other benefits are also available through the SLB flexible benefits program.  

**Flexible working**
We are open to flexible, hybrid working with a combination of on\-site \& home working days.  

**Certifications and Awards**
* We are proudly recognized as a disability\-confident, committed level employer.
* The Disability Equality Index awarded us the title of "Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion" in 2023\.
* Ranked among LinkedIn's "top companies in the UK for career development" for 2024\.
* Proud members of Business Disability Inn and the Valuable 500 initiative.
* Proudly ranked 4\.3 out of 5 on Glassdoor for Equality, Diversity and Inclusion.
* Proudly ranked 4\.1 out of 5 on Glassdoor for overall employee benefits.
* Proudly ranked 4\.2 out of 5 overall on Indeed.
  

**Still want to know more about SLB?**
Why not follow some of these useful links below to learn more about us directly from some of our employees?
* **Our People \- hear our stories**
* **Our Stories \- women in STEM**
  

*SLB is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or other characteristics protected by law. \#SLB*
 **Benefits**
------------

### **International Opportunities**


Global adventure, broad exposure, and limitless learning await you. You'll be part of the most multi\-cultural and diverse team of experts in any industry, anywhere.


### **Insurance**


Health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents available from day one.


### **Learning Opportunities**


Global adventure, broad exposure, and limitless learning await you. You'll be part of the most multi\-cultural and diverse team of experts in any industry, anywhere.


### **Diverse and Inclusive**


Our exceptional and diverse people are the pulse and spirit of who we are. Every day, you will enrich your knowledge in an environment where differences in thought, creativity and experiences are embraced.


**About Us**
------------


We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.


Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**\*\*This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK to be considered\*\***

**Overview**

You’ll be a senior member of the Engineering Reliability Team that will work closely with Zen’s development, engineering, and operations centre teams. You’ll Work alongside the Development and engineering teams, to support, maintain, and consistently improve the development estate so the development teams can focus and innovate constantly to drive Zen’s business and the teams’ priorities.

Reporting to the DevOps team manager, you must have an excellent track record in DevOps roles and the drive and attitude to succeed. Zen are committed to investing in and developing you – we believe that everyone can lead and the way we do has a huge impact on our people and play a vital part in our success.

The DevOps team will be responsible for the design and implementation of applications' build, release, deployment and configuration activities. Other responsibilities include working within multi\-functional teams to gather requirements, evaluate tools, implementing/updating solutions, building and executing test plans, provision environments, application performance reviews, assist migration of Legacy systems, and triaging and fixing operational issues.

You’ll ensure incidents are run smoothly and ensure that operational knowledge is available and shared. As a senior you will be a point of escalation, demonstrating problem solving skills, the ability to learn quickly and adapt your skills and knowledge.

As a service provider we operate many technologies, so you’ll have the skills to work with experienced Lead DevOps engineers, Systems Engineers and developers leveraging frameworks, standards, and defined operational process to make the unfamiliar comfortable and familiar. Over time we’ll increasingly leverage SRE principles to further optimize and enhance capabilities – it’s a great opportunity to get in at the start and shape this journey.

**Objectives**

* Deliver continuous incremental improvement of systems and infrastructure
* Take end to end ownership and responsibility for development infrastructure and systems
* Be a technical escalation point and eventually be part of a 24/7 escalation rota
* Document as you go – enough so your colleagues can follow what’s been done and why
* Drive tasks forward with energy and enthusiasm
* Create proactive monitoring solutions using standard tooling \- mainly Zabbix and Elastic
* Conduct RCA (Root Cause Analysis) for incidents
* Develop standard operational procedures and documentation
* Develop and maintain self\-managing infrastructure services and dashboards.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities
* Provide advice on DevOps standards and practices

· Provide coaching and mentoring to Software and DevOps Engineer peers

**Key Responsibilities**

**Experience**

· Worked and succeeded as a DevOps Engineer

· Ideally, experience working in an ISP, Telco or other Managed Services environment or able to demonstrate experience in a complex heterogeneous environment

· Strong adaptable scripting experience – ideally C\#/JavaScript/typescript/.Net

· Comfortable working with automation tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab, Puppet)

· Worked in complex networking and firewall environments

· Production use of multiple AWS capabilities and Kubernetes debugging

· Demonstratable experience in dealing with technical debt effectively

· Comfortable working with SRE principles and lean methodologies

**Skills \- Essential**

* Very strong problem\-solving skills are essential – understanding of DevOps and SRE concepts with the ability to apply key techniques to unfamiliar problems
* Ability to influence others in matters of standards and best practice, especially individuals outside of our team
* Comfortable working with automation tools (Puppet, Git) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) with complex integrations and test frameworks
* Experience using containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes etc)
* Comfortable with Elasticsearch log standardisation, Kibana dashboard creation and data analysis skills
* Able to code to a good level \- this isn’t a developer role but you need scripting skills to succeed
* AWS hands on – Cloud formation, Route53, S3, DynamoDB, Cloud\-watch, Lambda, Security, and troubleshooting
* Certificate management and automation
* Strong troubleshooting and diagnosis skills
* Able to write documentation that covers what your peers and operations need to know
* Knowledge of Database systems and models
* Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS and Linux

**Interpersonal Skills**

We value interpersonal skills and responsible teamwork. You should be able to:

* Patient \& friendly with excellent interpersonal skills \- demonstrate a natural aptitude for dealing with people
* Influence and lead
* Strong attention to detail
* Happy working and supporting a small closeknit team
* Take and give feedback to tune future actions and behaviours
* Embrace and demonstrate Zen values
* Be kind, understanding, and listen to others
* Be organized

**Impact You'll Make**

You will be influencing and contributing to Zen’s long\-term goals and joining a family that believes business should be a force for good. We’re a company committed to improving the lives of our people, creating a better future through our community and charity work, and ensuring that we look after our environment.

Perhaps that’s why we’re officially a Great Place to Work and have achieved Carbon Neutral Plus status and B Corp Certification!

* Bereavement leave
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Employee mentoring programme
* Enhanced maternity leave
* Free parking
* Life insurance
* Paid volunteer time
* Sick pay
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Innovation Developer
jobs.description:
Higher education is undergoing a revolution, and Lancaster University is helping to lead it. As one of the world’s top universities, we have a strong tradition of innovation, and our future will be shaped by the opportunities created by new technologies.


Information Systems Services is seeking a Developer to join our Innovation Team.


Digital innovation is at the heart of our strategy and ambition. In the Innovation Team, we are focused on developing new ways of delivering the best experience possible for all our students and staff, whether they are based at our green Campus or located at home, wherever that may be in the world. Joining us is your chance to help lead the transformation.


**The Opportunity**


We are searching for a developer, to play a role in our creative and forward\-thinking team. The main purpose of this role is to be a developer throughout the full development stack on our innovation and mobile solutions. You will need to work with cloud and on\-premise development tools and framework, be able to mentor temporary staff in best practice and be willing to work across a range of emerging frameworks.


**What you will need**


You must have experience in programming languages and frameworks of C\# and React and have some experience of working with AWS and Azure. Experience of GIT for source code management and revision control.


Please refer to the included job description and person specification for further details of essential and desirable qualifications for the role.


The role is primarily based on the Lancaster University Bailrigg campus, with flexible hybrid working options to support a positive work\-life balance. We would expect a minimum of 3 days a week in the office, working flexibly to adapt to the needs of the role.


**So why us?**


You would be joining an agile, innovative team working to provide applications and services which have high impact and visibility. We are committed to supporting our new team members including students and have built an environment that fosters knowledge sharing and consideration of others.


This is a great opportunity for an experienced developer to have a transformative impact on the student experience of digital learning and further their own career with a global leader in Higher Education.


Please contact Brian Green (brian.green@lancaster.ac.uk), Head of Innovation and Mobile Development, if you have any questions and would like to informally discuss the role.

jobs.title: Graduate Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
**Ready to launch your career?**

  

Join Amey and **start building a career with real impact.**

  

We are excited to offer a fantastic opportunity for a Civil Engineer Graduate to join our NMC NE team based in Perth. Whether you are finishing university or looking for the next step in your career, this is a great place to develop your skills, confidence and future career.

 **Starting Salary:** £30,000\.00 per annum (Subject to review)

**Location****:** Caledonian House, West Kinfauns, Perth. PH2 7XZ

**Working hours per week:** Monday to Friday, 9\.00 am to 5\.00 pm, 40 hours per week.

**Start date****:** July 2027

  

Our two\-year Graduate Pathway will challenge and inspire you to reach your full potential and build your career, with a guaranteed permanent position to transition into on completion. Throughout the programme, you will receive first\-class mentoring and structured learning and development to support your professional and personal growth. We will also contribute towards a relevant professional qualification.

 **About the team:**


Join our supportive and inclusive team within NMC NE, where you will work on projects that make a real difference to communities across the UK.


Amey is working in partnership with Transport Scotland Northeast since August 2022, with an increased focus on supporting the creation of sustainable futures for communities, together we will achieve net zero targets and improve the customer experience. Covering 593Km of network, we provide routine highways, bridges and structure maintenance as well as designing and managing road safety schemes. By ensuring our roads and highways are well\-maintained through all\-weather seasons and traffic incidents, we aim to create well\-functioning, safe spaces which minimise disruption, keep people moving and support thriving communities.

 **What you will do:**

* Plan and undertake specialist investigations.
* Assist with preparing technical documents and reports.
* Maintain high technical standards consistent with the project scope/brief.
* Provide design and specialist advice in relevant specialisms, e.g. pavements.
* Use of Transport Scotland’s Asset Management Performance System (AMPS) for scheme identification, development and recording of maintenance intervention.
* Assist the project manager with project related correspondence from internal and external stakeholders.
* Assist the project manager with Technical Workshops to discuss complex schemes and treatment proposals.
* Ensure compliance with relevant Health and Safety Legislation (CDM2015\).
* Ensure compliance at all times with the operating company's management system.
 **What you will bring:**


We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, keen to learn and ready to develop their career within a supportive and collaborative team.

* Minimum 2:2 degree in Civil Engineering.
* Full UK driving licence.
  

Behavioural competencies

* Passion for developing your skills, both professionally and personally.
* Enthusiasm for being part of a high\-performing team and a drive for success.
  

Please note that successful applicants will be required to undergo drug and alcohol testing, in line with our commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant working environment.


Please upload your certificates, predicted grades or achieved qualifications with your application, as this information will be used during shortlisting. Any offer of employment is conditional upon meeting the required academic criteria. If you experience any issues uploading documents, please contact our People Services team.

 **Why join Amey?**


At Amey, we work on long\-term stable contracts so you can plan a long\-term career with us. We have been awarded Platinum status by Investors in People which underscores our commitment to supporting our people across every part of our organisation, enabling them to shine. Whether you are starting your career, returning to the workplace or can bring your professional expertise and skills, there is a place for you here.


Our benefits are designed to help you thrive at work and in your home life. You will have the flexibility to choose benefits and development opportunities that are best for you.

* **Salary and rewards:**Enjoy a competitive annual salary with the potential for yearly reviews to ensure you are rewarded for your contributions.
* **All\-round suppor**t: You will be supported throughout your graduate pathway by your manager, mentor, Early Careers team and wider graduate network.
* **Career Growth:** Throughout your graduate pathway, you will receive first\-class mentoring and a structured learning and development programme to enable your professional and personal development.
* **Training Opportunities:**Unlock your potential with comprehensive training, including fully funded leadership programmes tailored to your personal growth.
* **Career pathways:** Your graduate pathway can open the door to future opportunities across Amey, helping you build a long\-term career after your programme.
* **Holidays** \- Enjoy 24 days leave plus bank holidays and the opportunity to buy more
* **Pension** \- Generous pension scheme, with extra contributions from Amey
* **Flexible working** \- Work\-life balance and flexibility are key for our success. We empower our people to make choices that are right for them, with hybrid, part\-time and flexible work patterns open for discussion.
* **Flexible benefits** – Customise your benefits with options such as insurance benefits, Cycle2Work scheme and access to discounted gym membership.
* **Exclusive Discounts**\- Access our online portal filled with discounts from leading retailers, healthcare services, and more, helping you save on the things that matter.
* **Social Value** – you will get two Social Impact Days each year to volunteer for a charity of your choice and further opportunities to support fundraising initiatives and, where eligible, participate in the Duke of Edinburgh Gold Award.
* **Family friendly policies** for new parents or if you provide care for a dependant
* **Membership of our Affinity Networks**who connect, support and inspire diverse communities within Amey
 **About Amey**


Amey is a global, integrated infrastructure consultancy and operations partner. We design, deliver, protect, and maintain critical assets and systems.

  

  

We advise, design, finance, deliver, and enhance civic, transport, and defence systems. By combining strategic intelligence, engineering, infrastructure finance, and operational expertise, we create secure, resilient, compliant, and high\-value outcomes across the lifecycles of new and legacy assets.

  

What truly defines Amey is our commitment to people. Our business is only as strong as the individuals who power it, and our greatest asset is our team. If you're ready to learn, grow and start building a career with real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

  

  

To find out more take a look at our website Early careers \| Amey

 **Application Guidance and Diversity \& Inclusion**


At Amey we constantly evolve how we work to reflect the different needs and backgrounds of our employees. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age. We believe everyone deserves an opportunity to shine.

  

As a disability confident leader, we’re proud to guarantee applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role.

  

Please contact our recruitment team at peopleservices@amey.co.uk to discuss any access needs, reasonable adjustments or additional support that you may require at any point during the recruitment process.

  

Apply today. We are excited to hear from you!

  

\*\*\*We may close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications. Please apply as soon as possible\*\*\*

  

\#CVL

jobs.title: Growth Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Growth Operations Engineer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of optimizing our technical infrastructure, ensuring seamless deployment, scaling, and maintenance of our growth\-focused platforms. Your expertise will drive efficiency, reliability, and scalability across our cloud and on\-premises environments, empowering us to accelerate user engagement and business expansion. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and possess a passion for cutting\-edge technology, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure using tools such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and OpenStack to support growth initiatives.
* Automate deployment pipelines with Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, and Shell Scripting to streamline software releases and updates.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues proactively using tools like New Relic, Splunk, Elasticsearch, and Nagios to ensure high availability.
* Collaborate with development teams on microservices architecture utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, Weblogic, JBoss, Tomcat, WebSphere, and REST APIs for efficient service delivery.
* Maintain configuration management and version control using SVN, GitHub, GitLab, TFS, or similar platforms to ensure consistency across environments.
* Conduct disaster recovery planning and implement strategies to safeguard data integrity and system resilience in cloud and on\-premises setups.
* Support software development lifecycle (SDLC), including system testing, debugging, release management, and continuous integration practices.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience with cloud computing platforms such as AWS (Amazon Web Services), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies including VMware and Virtualization concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying scalable applications.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash (Unix shell), Groovy or Perl for automation tasks.
* Familiarity with database systems including MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database or T\-SQL for data management.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP protocols, firewalls, DNS, WAN/LAN configurations and TCP socket programming.
* Experience with DevOps practices such as continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), release management and system testing.
* Knowledge of software development frameworks like Ruby on Rails or.NET is a plus.
* Ability to gather requirements effectively through collaboration with cross\-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills combined with a proactive approach to incident management and system optimization.

Join us as a Growth Operations Engineer to help shape the future of our platform’s scalability and reliability! We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where innovation thrives—empowering you to grow your skills while making a meaningful impact on our business growth journey.

Pay: £26,672\.47\-£66,428\.64 per year

Application question(s):

* Please create a 60\-second introduction video highlighting your experience, relevant skills, and professional background, then upload the video and paste the shareable link here.

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?  

  

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies \- all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add\-on channels which they can cancel at any time and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast\-paced, growth business \- available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Testing Prime Video features that run on Living Room devices (TVs, Set\-top boxes)
* Manual test execution on devices
* Collaborating with device partners (TV manufacturers, Set\-top box manufacturers) during the testing process
* Designing and developing the test\-suite used to validate Prime Video features
* Collaborating with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to develop, maintain and fix tests, both manual and automated, based on test results
* Collaborating with other team members to ensure the Prime Video certification process maintains its high quality bar
* Leveraging AI to improve speed and quality of tests

  

About the team  

The Device Partnerships organization works directly with third\-party device manufacturers (e.g. Samsung, LG, Sony) and distributors to ensure that Prime Video works seamlessly on any living room device across the globe.  

  

The certification team ensure that every living room device (TV, set\-top box) delivers the high\-quality experience that customers expect from Prime Video. This quality will be viewed by many millions of customers.  

  

The team also manages and monitors the software running on these devices to ensure that they do not regress after they have been certified.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.title: Sr. Electrical Engineer, Sustainability Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.  

  

You will join a team which:  

* Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
* Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high\-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low\-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
* Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
* Drives end\-to\-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
* Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
* Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

  

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona  

  

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net\-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders
* Perform design validation and review to ensure compliance with established electrical standards during installation and commissioning of infrastructure
* Act as subject matter expert (SME) for LV and HV (up to 24kV) electrical systems
* Align stakeholder expectations and define technical requirements for EV charging network infrastructure and smart grid deployments
* Drive the technology roadmap for electrical infrastructure, including EV chargers, substations, energy efficiency solutions, and IoT technologies (e.g. smart metres)
* Develop business cases and present recommendations to leadership to secure approval for programme scoping and investment decisions
* Coordinate with programme managers to ensure quality and standards compliance across large\-scale installations
* Drive process improvement across commissioning, audit, value engineering, and cost control activities

  

A day in the life  

Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short\-, mid\-, and long\-term technical decisions with large\-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability \& Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.  

  

About the team  

The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. We manage supply chain, procurement, and maintenance activities, and define the processes that ensure consistent, scalable delivery. To enable this, the team develops and continuously improves electrical standards and technologies that underpin reliable, compliant deployment at pace. * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a foreign equivalent
* Experience with design \& innovation and research \& development
* Experience in management of engineering design projects
* Experience using business or technical software like MS Excel, MS Project, and CAD software

* Master's degree in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
* Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, electronic system design, and decision making
* Experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high\-speed manufacturing
* Experience with design\-in\-safety

jobs.title: Acoustic Modelling & Simulation Engineer (for projects in Sweden)
jobs.description:
### **Job Description**


At AFRY, we believe that sound has the power to shape how people experience the places where they live, work and meet.


We are now looking for an Acoustician with a strong background in building acoustics and environmental noise to join our growing Acoustics, Sound and Vibration team in Sweden, with around 80 acousticians across the country.


This is an opportunity for an ambitious acoustic engineer who wants to work on challenging projects, collaborate with leading specialists across disciplines and contribute to projects both in Sweden and internationally.


As an Acoustician at AFRY, you will work with a broad range of projects within building acoustics and environmental noise. You will be involved from early\-stage studies and concept development through detailed design and construction.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Building acoustics and acoustic design of residential, office, educational, healthcare and public buildings
* Environmental noise assessments related to road and rail traffic, industry and urban development
* Acoustic calculations, modelling and simulations
* Noise mapping and prediction
* Evaluation of acoustic measurements
* Development of acoustic solutions, strategies and mitigation measures
* Preparation of technical specifications
* Providing expert advice to project teams

You will have the opportunity to work across the full project lifecycle and develop your expertise in the areas where you can create the greatest value.


### **Qualifications**


**Must have:**


* A university degree in acoustics, engineering, physics, building physics or a related field
* 5\+ years of professional experience as an acoustician or acoustic consultant
* Solid experience in building acoustics and/or environmental noise
* Experience of acoustic calculations, modelling and technical analysis
* Experience working in multidisciplinary construction or infrastructure projects
* The ability to communicate complex acoustic issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* A structured and independent way of working
* Strong written and spoken English

Experience in building acoustics within **healthcare projects** is particularly valuable.


Experience with software such as SoundPLAN, CadnaA, CadnaB, SONArchitect, INSUL, Bastian, Odeon, Treble, Rhino/Grasshopper, Sketchup, AutoCAD, Revit, BIM is an advantage. Experience with equivalent tools is also highly relevant.


Knowledge of Swedish acoustic standards and regulations is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.


Knowledge and experience within the following areas are particularly valuable:


* Façade and window sound insulation calculations with respect to road and rail traffic noise
* Airborne sound insulation calculations between rooms
* Impact sound insulation calculations between rooms
* Preparation of drawings and documentation specifying acoustic requirements for walls, glazed partitions and doors
* Sound transmission calculations between rooms, including break\-in and break\-out noise through ventilation ducts
* Noise assessment of air handling units and ventilation fan systems
* Room acoustic simulations and calculations, including reverberation time and Speech Transmission Index (STI).

### **Company Description**


AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.


AFRY employs over 18,000 professionals in more than 50 countries. Net sales in 2024 were SEK 27,160 million.


AFRY is organized into three Divisions: Energy; Industry and Transportation \& Places.


The Global Division Transportation \& Places is active within transportation infrastructure, real estate, water and environment in the Nordics and Central Europe. The division has about 6,500 employees and is structured around two segments: Road \& Rail and Public \& Commercial Places.


### **Additional Information**


To individuals who join our team, we offer:


* Employment based on an employment contract
* Private medical insurance, life assurance, sport card (Multisport) and a social found
* 50% tax\-deductible costs for income from creative activities managed by the employer
* Exciting and challenging projects
* Personal development opportunities
* Friendly working atmosphere in a multidisciplinary and international team
* Helping to shape a sustainable future

Available office locations for this position are either in Poznań, Kraków or Łódź. We are ﬂexible on the office location for this position, please indicate your preference in your covering letter. We value a healthy work life balance and are committed to your wellbeing. We will operate a hybrid working environment.


*We are excited to receive your application,* ***please ensure your CV is in English****.*


Should you be successful you will be invited for a telephone interview followed by a 2 steps virtual or live face to face interview.


*At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.*

We are looking for a senior backend developer in Hørsholm, Denmark or in Gdynia, Poland, to help develop the application of the MUSE Software \- DHI’s integrated offshore wind bird\- and bat\-monitoring and decision\-support system, serving wind farms across the world.


**About DHI**


DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge technologies and products to the market. DHI is fund\-owned, meaning that profit goes to a purpose and not shareholders.


**Responsibilities and challenges**


You will work on designing and delivering the MUSE application and making a difference for endangered birds across the world.


You will be a part of a friendly and diverse team located both in Hørsholm and across Europe. Everyone is passionate about the product and striving to provide our clients with outstanding technical advice and customer service.


**The main responsibilities and challenges in the job are:**


* Design, develop the software application (full stack, mainly backend but there are minor frontend work)
* Contribute to architecture and technical design of the solution
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance, stability and functional issues
* Collaborate closely with local and international colleagues across disciplines spanning Software, infrastructure, hardware and scientific
* Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing

We expect the following qualifications:


* Bachelor or master degree within computer science or similar
* Minimum 6–8 years of experience in backend development

* Strong expertise in C\# with .NET Core
* Experience with, or strong desire to learn:
	+ Sensor networks
	+ Streaming architecture
	+ Event\-based programming
	+ Microservices
	+ Agile/Scrum work practice
Good communication skills in English (written and spoken)  
* 

Nice to have experience with:

* SQL Databases

* Camera / hardware integration experience

Control systems fundamentals \- PID  
* 

Personal skills


* Self\-motivated and proactive
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Structured and quality\-oriented
* Solution\-minded with a focus on delivering value
* A strong drive and desire to learn new skills and areas

**We offer**


To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that contributes to solving some of the world’s most important challenges within water and environment.


We offer:


* Highly skilled and motivated colleagues
* Opportunity to work in an international and collaborative environment
* Flexible working conditions
* A unique chance to contribute to solutions with real\-world environmental impact

You will be located in our office either in Hørsholm, Denmark or in Gdynia, Poland, with close collaboration with international colleagues.

Please submit your application including CV via the relevant job posting on DHI’s website.

* For further information, please contact: Louise Mærsk, mail: lorm@dhigroup.com, mobile: \+45 61 33 51 33

**Deadline:**
**Expected start date:** 01/11/2026

Louise Rosenberg Maersk lorm@dhigroup.com

DHI are the first people you should call when you have a tough challenge to solve in a water environment – be it a river, a reservoir, an ocean, a coastline, within a city or a factory.
  

  

Our knowledge of water environments is second\-to\-none. It represents 50 years of dedicated research and real\-life experience from more than 140 countries. zł87,000 Annual

jobs.description:
**Bring more to life.**

  

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

Our 60,000\+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

  

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

  

DHR Enterprise AI Solutions is Danaher's enterprise AI engineering capability, responsible for identifying opportunities, building and scaling reusable AI solutions, and accelerating measurable business impact across operating companies. We combine product, architecture, AI science, engineering and operations to industrialise AI, establish enterprise standards and enable the next generation of AI\-powered products, workflows, applications and decision\-making.

  

The Principal Full Stack Engineer is responsible for rapidly turning high\-priority AI opportunities into compelling end\-to\-end prototypes and reusable application patterns. This role serves as a strategic technical leader within the Enterprise AI Solutions organization, driving software engineering excellence, modern application architecture, and scalable cloud\-native solutions that enable AI adoption. You will work across business domains, AI engineering teams, platform and data teams, security, architecture, and product management teams to design and deliver highly scalable, secure, and maintainable AI applications across Danaher.

  

This is a Danaher Corporate role, hosted by our Cytiva operating company in Kraków, and will be an on\-site role (Kraków).

 **In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

  

* Lead, design, build and integrate highly scalable full\-stack solutions leveraging modern front\- and back\-end frameworks, cloud\-native architectures, APIs, microservices, and AI technologies.
* Define software architecture patterns, applying this capability across our organisation to build, industrialise and scale trusted, reusable AI solutions.
* Integrate and link AI solutions to instruments to scale physical AI.
* Establish reusable development frameworks, accelerators, libraries, and reference architectures to improve engineering productivity and consistency while mentoring the team members with technical leadership.
* Champion secure\-by\-design principles, software quality practices, observability standards, and DevSecOps adoption throughout the development lifecycle.
* Lead technical design reviews, architectural governance, and engineering best practices across multiple AI initiatives and product teams.

 **The Essential Requirements of the Job Include:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 15 Plus years of experience in software engineering with demonstrated success in designing and delivering large\-scale enterprise applications especially on cloud native with building AI solutions.
* Proven hands\-on experience in designing cloud\-native applications, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
* Technical expertise in .net core/C\#, Python, React/Angular, Azure/AWS, Kubernetes services, Open AI, Vector Database, Snowflake, Postgress, Prompt Engineering, SQL, Agent frame works.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives involving multiple operating companies and global stakeholders. Drive innovation by identifying emerging technologies and translating them into business value.

 **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

  

* Agentic AI platforms and autonomous workflow systems. Enterprise Copilot and AI assistant development. Implementation of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture.
* Data engineering and analytics platforms.
* Enterprise software modernization and digital transformation programs lead the Enterprise teams for the solutions.

  

\#LI\-KK1

  

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

jobs.title: Software Architect (.NET) (k/m/n)
jobs.description:
Nexio Management to około 550 konsultantów, którzy od ponad 20 lat tworzą zaawansowane rozwiązania IT dla firm w Polsce i za granicą. Jesteśmy zespołem ekspertów, którzy realnie angażują się w projekty swoich klientów.
  

  

Specjalizujemy się w budowie, rozwoju i utrzymaniu systemów i aplikacji, oraz doradztwie IT. Wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają wtedy, gdy jest przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie \- dlatego mamy własne R\&D Center na czele z NexioBot naszym mobilnym robotem asystującym, wykorzystującym sztuczną inteligencję do komunikacji.
  

  

Działamy w takich modelach biznesowych jak managed services, fixed prices oraz wspieramy zespoły naszych klientów w modelach scale up the team. Naszymi klientami są firmy z wielu zróżnicowanych branż, szukające wsparcia najwyższej klasy ekspertów.


**Opis stanowiska**
-------------------


Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy **Architekta IT / Software Architecta**, który będzie odpowiedzialny za projektowanie i rozwój architektury systemów oraz wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w procesie transformacji technologicznej.


Szukamy osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na stykutechnologii i biznesu, potrafi podejmować samodzielne decyzje architektoniczne, ale jednocześnie potrafi przełożyć je na konkretne rozwiązania i jasno wyjaśnić ich uzasadnienie.


**Twój zakres obowiązków**
--------------------------


* Projektowanie architektury nowych oraz istniejących systemów, zarówno monolitycznych, jak i opartych o mikroserwisy.
* Prowadzenie i wspieranie procesów modernizacyjnych, w tym refaktoryzacji i migracji systemów.
* Przeprowadzanie analiz technicznych oraz tworzenie dokumentacji architektonicznej.
* Udział w projektach transformacji technologicznej w roli eksperta technologicznego i partnera dla biznesu.
* Rekomendowanie oraz dobór technologii z uwzględnieniem bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i skalowalności.
* Projektowanie i rozwój rozwiązań opartych o API.
* Wsparcie zespołów developerskich w podejmowaniu decyzji technicznych.
* Dzielenie się wiedzą i mentoring techniczny.
* Identyfikowanie obszarów wymagających usprawnień oraz proponowanie kierunków rozwoju architektury.
* Współpraca z zespołami IT, biznesem oraz innymi interesariuszami.
**Nasze wymagania**
-------------------


* Bardzo dobra znajomość **.NET Framework** oraz **.NET Core / .NET 6\+**.
* Doświadczenie w pracy z **PHP 5\.x\-8\.x** oraz starszymi frameworkami, np. Zend, Symfony 2/3\.
* Praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z monolitami oraz ich modernizacji.
* Dobra znajomość **SQL** oraz relacyjnych baz danych, w szczególności **MS SQL, MySQL lub PostgreSQL**.
* Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i budowie **API \- REST, SOAP**; znajomość GraphQL będzie dodatkowym atutem.
* Znajomość wzorców architektonicznych, w szczególności **DDD** (Domain\-Driven Design).
* Umiejętność analizy technicznej i podejmowania decyzji architektonicznych.
* Umiejętność przekładania decyzji technicznych i ich konsekwencji na język biznesu.
* Proaktywne podejście i gotowość do proponowania usprawnień oraz nowych kierunków rozwoju.
* Bardzo dobre umiejętności komunikacyjne i umiejętność współpracy zarówno z zespołami IT, jak i biznesem.
* Samodzielność w podejmowaniu decyzji technicznych.
**To oferujemy**
----------------


* Stabilność zatrudnienia \- długofalowe projekty, współpraca z wiodącymi firmami, możliwość rozwoju w różnych obszarach branży IT.
* Elastyczne formy współpracy \- umowa B2B, umowa o pracę lub zlecenie.
* Benefity: Medicover (rozszerzony o stomatologię), FitProfit, lekcje języka angielskiego.
* Treningi na siłowni F45 \- zlokalizowanej w naszym biurze. Wspólnie ćwiczymy pod okiem profesjonalnych trenerów.
* Wewnętrzny program poleceń.
* Możliwość finansowania certyfikatów IT.
* W zależności od projektu pracujemy w trybie hybrydowym, zdalnym lub stacjonarnym.
* Wydarzenia okolicznościowe oraz wyjazdy integracyjne \- budujemy zgrany zespól również poza biurem.
* Lubimy pomagać \- wspieramy akcje charytatywne, takie jak Szlachetna Paczka, a w ramach \#PomagamyNexio angażujemy się tam, gdzie naprawdę możemy coś zmienić.

jobs.title: Systemarkitekt inom C#/.NET
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och digitalisera skogsindustrin och arbeta med teknik som gör verklig skillnad för miljö och hållbarhet? Nu söker vi en Systemarkitekt till ett växande bolag här i Göteborg som utvecklar avancerade system för att effektivisera skogsbruket. Ansök idag\- vi tillämpar löpande urval!
  
  

**OM TJÄNSTEN:**  

I den här rollen får du en central position i ett sammansvetsat utvecklingsteam där du är med och bygger lösningar från grunden och vidareutvecklar befintliga system.
  
Du kommer att arbeta nära slutkunden, vilket ger dig en djup förståelse för verksamhetens behov och hur systemen används i praktiken. Det innebär också korta beslutsvägar och en nära dialog med användare, vilket gör att du snabbt ser effekten av det du utvecklar.
  
Bolaget fokuserar på att digitalisera och effektivisera skogsindustrin genom datadrivna lösningar. En viktig del av arbetet är system kopplade till GIS (geografiska informationssystem), där data används för att exempelvis analysera miljöförändringar, vattennivåer och andra faktorer som påverkar skogsbruket. Du kommer därför att arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan mjukvaruutveckling, dataanalys och verkliga tillämpningar. Tekniskt innebär rollen främst backendutveckling i C\#/.NET, ofta i molnbaserade miljöer inom Microsoft Azure.
  
  

**ARBETSUPPGIFTER:** Utveckla och förbättra molnbaserade applikationer inom Microsoft Azure
  
Arbeta med backendutveckling i C\#/.NET
  
Bidra till lösningar inom GIS och datadrivna analyser
  
Samarbeta nära både interna utvecklare och kund
  
Vara med och effektivisera processer inom skogsindustrin
  
**VI SÖKER DIG SOM:** Har en kandidat\- eller masterexamen inom mjukvaruutveckling, datateknik eller ett annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant
  
Har några års arbetslivserfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
  
Har arbetslivserfarenhet inom C\#/.NET
  
  

**Det inte nödvändigt, men meriterande om du har:**  

Erfarenhet av eller intresse för GIS\-system
  
Arbetslivserfarenhet från skogsindustrin
  
Har erfarenhet av Python och/eller C/C\+\+
  
  

Vidare lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken och framåt, som inte tvekar att ställa frågor när något är oklart och som trivs i att samarbeta med andra. Du är en lagspelare som aktivt bidrar till en positiv och inkluderande teamkultur. Utöver det sitter vår kund i mycket trivsamma, ljusa lokaler där du har tillgång till gemensamt gym.
  
  

**OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:**  

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer till en början att vara anställd av Friday. Ambitionen från kund och vår sida är att du därefter bli tillsvidareanställd hos kundföretaget.
  
**ÖVRIG INFO:** Omfattning: Heltid
  
**Start:** Enligt överenskommelse
  
**Placering:** Göteborg
  
**Lön:** Marknadsmässig månadslön
  
  

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.
  
  

**OM FRIDAY:**  

På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech\-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
  
Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.
  
Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Solna, Sweden


* Full\-time
* Application and Product Development
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide employees in health regions and municipalities with product offerings that help them in their daily work, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

 **About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory\- and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

 **About the role**


The open position is with our DDC PRS product team. We provide personnel\- and workforce management solutions to health regions and municipalities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will have a close dialogue with our customers. Furthermore, you will work closely with our architects, developers and application specialists. It is important that you contribute to improving processes and further contribute to us creating solutions that meet the customers' needs and create value for them. We are looking for you who are outgoing, quality\-conscious and work in a structured and systematic manner.  

Good communication skills both in writing and orally are a requirement.

 **In this role you will mainly:**

* Install and upgrade Tieto Workforce Planner with associated applications in internal test environments and with existing and new customers.
* Carry out packaging, technical verification and delivery of new versions of the software.
* Help move on\-prem infrastructure to cloud both internal as well as customer installations.
* Contribute to maintaining Workforce Planner in a cloud environment
* Improve and automate solutions for software packaging, delivery and deployment of the product.
* Maintain and improve technical documentation for installation of the solution.
* Maintain internal environments.
* Carry out migration of the solutions from old to new servers when customers upgrade infrastructure.
* Assist technical operations staff at the customer when necessary.

 **Secondary you will:**

* Develop SQL scripts to meet the customer's needs for customized data extraction.
* Maintain and improve infrastructure for automated testing.
* Testing web service APIs.
* Optimize database queries.

 **It is an absolute requirement that you master both Norwegian and English fluently in writing and orally.**

 **We are looking for someone with:**

* 3\-year education in ICT.
	+ Relevant experience can compensate for a lack of formal education.
* Experience with:
	+ Azure DevOps and pipelines.
	+ Windows Server and management of rights, certificates.
	+ IIS and configuration of web applications.
	+ SQL Server and SQL script.
	+ PowerShell / bat\-scripting.
* Good communication skills

 **It would be beneficial if you also:**

* Version management systems such as Git.
* Container frameworks such as Docker.
* Programming skills in C\#.
* Testing web services with Bruno/Postman or similar tools.
* Infrastructure management on Azure.

 **AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarizing, analyzing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing products beneficial for health regions and municipalities. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, an open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

 **Could you be our new colleague?**


We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Svein Johan Hauge, svein.johan.hauge@tieto.com

 *We perform background checks on all final candidates.*

*Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion \| Sustainability \| Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud \| Tieto Blog

  
We provide customers across different industries with mission\-critical solutions through our specialized software businesses Tieto Caretech, Tieto Banktech and Tieto Indtech as well as Tieto Tech Consulting business.


Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

jobs.title: Software Engineer-Flight Operations
jobs.description:
As a Software Engineer, you will work with your team on development of new features for the Avinode Flight Operations product offering. As a member of a product team made up of a Product Manager, UX Designer, Test Lead, and Software Engineers, you will plan, implement, and release business\-critical features for customers across the business aviation industry.

**What you will do**

* Working together with your teammates, develop appropriate technical solutions to implement new product features and improve current features. You will be working both in our existing C\# .NET monolith and React frontend as well as potentially developing new services.
* Work to bring our codebase up to date with current best practices, libraries, and platforms.
* Research and advocate for new technologies and techniques that would be beneficial to your team and/or the wider Engineering organisation.

**Who you are**

* You have 3\+ years of experience building systems in the .NET ecosystem and React frontends. You may be more specialised in the frontend or backend, but you will be expected to contribute to all parts of the stack when necessary.
* You have some experience working with relational databases and related technologies such as ORMs, and some proficiency with SQL (we use MS SQL Server, but experience with Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, etc. is fine).
* You are familiar with software development and delivery best practices, and are committed to consistently following the team’s standard practices.
* You communicate well. With offices in multiple time zones and multiple countries, this position requires strong written and verbal communication skills.

**What do we offer you?**


We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.

* Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations.
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important.
* Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams.

**Want to join our crew?**


Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Flight Operations - Backend
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer \- Flight Operations Backend**
=========================================================


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a leading role in the development of the Avinode Flight Operations product offering. As a member of a product team made up of a Product Manager, UX Designer, Test Lead, and Software Engineers, you will plan, implement, and release business\-critical features for customers across the business aviation industry.

**What you will do**

* Working together with your teammates, design appropriate technical solutions to implement new product features and improve current features. You will be working both in our existing C\# .NET monolith (with React frontend) as well as developing new services when needed.

* Work to bring our codebase up to date with current best practices, libraries, and platforms.
* Research and advocate for new technologies and techniques that would be beneficial to your team and/or the wider Engineering organisation.
