jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Fast stilling Heltid Oslo
* Søknadsfrist **Snarest**
* Arbeidsspråk **Norsk**
* Sektor **Privat**

  
**Senior dataingeniør, eiendoms\- og geodata**
==============================================


Vi søker en erfaren dataingeniør som vil bygge og drifte dataplattformen bak Placepoint. Du henter inn, modellerer og leverer eiendoms\-, selskaps\- og kartdata fra Norge og Sverige, sammen med oss to som gjør det i dag, og du bruker AI som et fast verktøy i jobben.


Om oss
Placepoint samler eiendomsinformasjon, eierskap, regulering, transaksjoner og kartdata i én plattform for Norge og Sverige. Over 850 kunder bruker oss, blant dem eiendomsbesittere, utviklere, banker, forsikringsselskaper, meglere og advokater. Vi er over 70 ansatte og holder til i Oslo sentrum.
  

Dataene er kjernen i det vi leverer. Vi henter dem fra offentlige registre som Matrikkelen, Grunnboken og Enhetsregisteret, fra svenske kilder som Lantmäteriet og Bolagsverket, og fra over 2 300 kartlag. Kundene bruker dem i Placepoint Fusion, Placepoint API og gjennom våre MCP\-servere som lar AI\-assistenter slå opp i dataene direkte.  

  



Slik jobber vi
AI er en del av hvordan vi utvikler. Hvert repo har instruksjoner for Claude Code og Cursor, mye av koden skrives sammen med en AI\-agent, og vi bygger egne MCP\-servere så kunder og kolleger kan bruke dataene våre fra Claude og andre assistenter. Vi forventer at du bruker AI mye, og at du er med på å finne ut hvordan vi kan bruke det bedre.
  

Vi er et lite datateam med bredt ansvar. Den som bygger et dataløp, drifter det også, og vi rydder opp i årsaken når noe feiler.  

  



Dette skal du jobbe med
* Utvikle og optimalisere databasene våre i SQL Server og PostGIS: lagrede prosedyrer, datamodeller, indekser, partisjonering og ytelse på store tabeller.
* Bygge og drifte dataløp som henter registerdata hver natt og hver uke, med Azure Data Factory, Python\-jobber i Azure og dbt.
* Følge med på at kjøringene går, finne feilen når de ikke gjør det, og gjøre dem robuste nok til at det skjer sjeldnere.
* Modellere og koble norske og svenske registre: eiendom, bygg, adresser, selskaper, roller, eierskap og transaksjoner.
* Videreutvikle Placepoint API, MCP\-serverne våre og søkeindeksene i Azure AI Search.
* Ta inn nye kartlag og datakilder, og holde dem oppdatert.
* Levere datasett til kunder og hjelpe kolleger i produkt og salg med data og analyser.

Vi ser etter deg som
* har minst seks års relevant arbeidserfaring
* har høyere utdanning innen informatikk, geomatikk, matematikk eller lignende, eller tilsvarende arbeidserfaring
* er svært god på SQL Server eller PostgreSQL: du skriver effektiv SQL, leser spørringsplaner, lager indekser som holder og modellerer data som skal leve lenge
* har bygget og driftet dataløp i produksjon, med Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt eller tilsvarende
* programmerer godt i Python eller C\#, gjerne begge
* bruker Claude, Cursor eller lignende AI\-verktøy mye i hverdagen, eller er motivert for å gjøre det
* snakker og skriver norsk flytende

Det er et pluss om du har erfaring med
* PostGIS og geodata: geometri, koordinatsystemer som EUREF89 UTM, GeoJSON, GeoParquet og vektorfliser
* norske registre og kartdata: Enhetsregisteret, Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Aksjonærregisteret og FKB fra Kartverket
* svenske registre og data: Lantmäteriet, Bolagsverket og SCB
* API\-design, MCP\-servere og søkemotorer som Azure AI Search eller Elasticsearch
* Azure: Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault og Data Lake
* Go
* 3D\-data og bygningsmodeller
* eiendomsbransjen eller finans

Ingen har alt dette. Vi jobber bredt, og du lærer nye verktøy mens du bruker dem. Det som veier tyngst, er at du lærer fort, bruker AI godt og bryr deg om at dataene er riktige.  

  



Om deg
* Du legger merke til når tall ikke stemmer, og graver til du finner årsaken.
* Du tar ansvar for det du lager, også etter at det er i drift.
* Du jobber selvstendig, deler det du finner og ber om hjelp når det sparer tid.
* Du kan forklare et datasett og begrensningene i det til en kollega som ikke er utvikler.
* Du trives med å jobbe på kontoret sammen med teamet.
**Ferdigheter**
---------------

* Data Engineering
* Data Modeling
* Kodegjennomgang
* kvalitetssikring av data
* Orkestrere musikk
* PostGIS
* Python (dataprogrammering)
* SQL

  
**Om arbeidsgiveren**
---------------------


Placepoint bygger dataplattformen for eiendom i Norge og Sverige.


Banker, eiendomsutviklere, investorer og rådgivere bruker plattformen til å finne, analysere og følge eiendommer, selskaper og planer, med data fra Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Brønnøysundregistrene, Lantmäteriet og en rekke andre kilder samlet på ett sted.


* Sted: Tordenskiolds Gate 2, 0177 Oslo
* Bransje: Eiendom, IT \- programvare
* Stillingsfunksjon: Dataingeniør
**Nøkkelord**
-------------


lakehouse, dbt, postgis, mcp, ETL



**Spørsmål om stillingen**
--------------------------


FF
Frede Fardal


CPO


JB
Jarle Bjørnbeth


Head of Data

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Fornebu, Norway


* Full\-time
* Application and Product Development
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide employees in health regions and municipalities with product offerings that help them in their daily work, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

 **About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory\- and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

 **About the role**


The open position is with our DDC PRS product team. We provide personnel\- and workforce management solutions to health regions and municipalities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will have a close dialogue with our customers. Furthermore, you will work closely with our architects, developers and application specialists. It is important that you contribute to improving processes and further contribute to us creating solutions that meet the customers' needs and create value for them. We are looking for you who are outgoing, quality\-conscious and work in a structured and systematic manner.  

Good communication skills both in writing and orally are a requirement.

 **In this role you will mainly:**

* Install and upgrade Tieto Workforce Planner with associated applications in internal test environments and with existing and new customers.
* Carry out packaging, technical verification and delivery of new versions of the software.
* Help move on\-prem infrastructure to cloud both internal as well as customer installations.
* Contribute to maintaining Workforce Planner in a cloud environment
* Improve and automate solutions for software packaging, delivery and deployment of the product.
* Maintain and improve technical documentation for installation of the solution.
* Maintain internal environments.
* Carry out migration of the solutions from old to new servers when customers upgrade infrastructure.
* Assist technical operations staff at the customer when necessary.

 **Secondary you will:**

* Develop SQL scripts to meet the customer's needs for customized data extraction.
* Maintain and improve infrastructure for automated testing.
* Testing web service APIs.
* Optimize database queries.

 **It is an absolute requirement that you master both Norwegian and English fluently in writing and orally.**

 **We are looking for someone with:**

* 3\-year education in ICT.
	+ Relevant experience can compensate for a lack of formal education.
* Experience with:
	+ Azure DevOps and pipelines.
	+ Windows Server and management of rights, certificates.
	+ IIS and configuration of web applications.
	+ SQL Server and SQL script.
	+ PowerShell / bat\-scripting.
* Good communication skills

 **It would be beneficial if you also:**

* Version management systems such as Git.
* Container frameworks such as Docker.
* Programming skills in C\#.
* Testing web services with Bruno/Postman or similar tools.
* Infrastructure management on Azure.

 **AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarizing, analyzing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing products beneficial for health regions and municipalities. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, an open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

 **Could you be our new colleague?**


We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Svein Johan Hauge, svein.johan.hauge@tieto.com

 *We perform background checks on all final candidates.*

*Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion \| Sustainability \| Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud \| Tieto Blog

  
We provide customers across different industries with mission\-critical solutions through our specialized software businesses Tieto Caretech, Tieto Banktech and Tieto Indtech as well as Tieto Tech Consulting business.


Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Stillingsbeskrivelse**
------------------------


Er du en engasjert tech\-entusiast som elsker å jobbe med moderne datateknologier? Hos Sopra Steria blir du en del av et inspirerende og inkluderende miljø – et av Norges råeste tech\-miljøer – hvor vi kombinerer utfordrende prosjekter med en kultur preget av nysgjerrighet, læring og samarbeid. Vi tror at du, med din evne til å tilegne deg ny kunnskap og din genuine interesse for teknologi, vil trives og vokse hos oss. Hos oss vil du bidra i varierte oppdrag på tvers av bransjer og sektorer, og være med på å utvikle morgendagens dataløsninger sammen med noen av Norges fremste fageksperter  

  

  

Her får du muligheten til å forme morgendagens dataløsninger i et dynamisk team med høyt kvalifiserte kollegaer.

**Ansvarsområder**:


* **Utvikling og design**  

Du vil være med å designe og sette opp event\-drevne arkitekturer. Ved å integrere meldingstjenester som Kafka og Pub/Sub, oppnår vi sanntids databehandling, rask respons og en robust, hendelsesbasert arkitektur som gir oss økt fleksibilitet og effektivitet.
* **Dataprosessering**  

Du jobber med distribuerte plattformer for å prosessere store datamengder. Dette innebærer avansert datamodellering for å strukturere, transformere og gjøre data om til verdifull innsikt.
* **Skyteknologier**  

Vil du være med å designe, sette opp og optimalisere løsninger på Azure, AWS og GCP? Her utnytter du tjenester for lagring, serverless computing og containere for å bygge systemer som er sikre, skalerbare og kostnadseffektive.
* **Infrastruktur som kode**  

Du vil være med på å designe og implementere skyinfrastruktur ved hjelp av moderne IaC\-verktøy, som Terraform, Biceps og tilsvarende.

  

I prosjektene våre vil du kombinere denne tekniske kompetansen med evnen til å forstå kundens behov, samarbeide godt med ulike fagmiljøer og levere løsninger som er robuste, optimaliserte og som skaper tydelig verdi for kundene våre.

**Kvalifikasjoner**:

* Høyere utdanning innen IT, dataingeniørfag eller beslektede fagområder.

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer (Europe, 100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join our fully remote, mission\-driven team dedicated to pioneering **sustainable inflight service management**. Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.


Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.


#### **About the role**


We are hiring a **Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer** to take **end\-to\-end ownership of our data platform and BI layer**.


We are on a mission to contribute to a **zero\-waste future** by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, **CO₂ emissions** in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision \- and as a **Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer** you will be at the forefront of turning data into meaningful insights, empowering our customers to effectively use them and drive real impact.


You will evolve a vendor\-built BI solution into a **modern, product\-grade data platform** and ensure that data is transformed into **scalable, trusted, and actionable insights** for both our customers and internal teams. You’re not just building dashboards, you’re enabling better decisions and measurable impact.


This role combines:

* **Data Engineering** (pipelines, processing, customer facing exports, platform)
* **Analytics Engineering** (modeling, KPIs, semantic layer)
* **Data Product Ownership** (customer impact, insight generation)

#### **What You’ll Own**

**Platform, Architecture \& Pipelines**


Own the end\-to\-end data platform (**Databricks** and **Microsoft Fabric**)

* Design and operate scalable pipelines and lakehouse architecture
* Build scalable ETL/ELT workflows and manage batch/near real\-time processing
* Ensure data quality, reliability, observability, and performance
* Define standards, data contracts, and architecture principles (clean, modular, scalable data platform)
* Optimize cost (e.g. Databricks jobs) and workload distribution across platforms

**Data Modeling \& Semantic Layer**

* Own **Power BI** semantic models and KPIs
* Build clean, scalable dimensional models (star schema)
* Ensure performance and consistency of DAX, aggregations, and dataset refresh

**Customer\-Facing Analytics**

* Build and maintain customer\-facing dashboards and embedded analytics
* Ensure consistent and trusted metrics across all outputs
* Enable self\-service analytics with governance
* Maintain and monitor customer facing exports

**Data as Product**

* Translate business and customer needs into scalable data solutions
* Define KPIs and reporting standards with Product
* Proactively build insights and identify opportunities to create additional customer value
* Drive measurable customer and business impact

**Platform Quality, Operations, Security \& Governance**

* Build necessary validation scripts, unit tests, data quality checks
* Implement CI/CD, testing, and versioning for pipelines and BI
* Support multi\-tenant architecture, security, and governance
* Implement monitoring and alerting (pipelines, refreshes)

**Migration \& Insourcing (Initial Focus)**

* Take ownership of a vendor\-built BI solution
* Reverse\-engineer pipelines, logic, and reports
* Reduce technical debt and rebuild toward a clean architecture

#### **What We’re Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5\+ years in data engineering / analytics engineering for customer\-facing BI products
* Experience in SaaS or product\-driven environments
* Proven track record building scalable data platforms and customer\-facing analytics

**Technical \& Platform Skills**

* Strong experience with:
	+ Databricks (Spark / PySpark, Delta Lake)
	+ Microsoft Fabric or Azure data stack
	+ Power BI (data modeling, DAX, performance)
* Advanced SQL and dimensional modeling (Kimball) expertise
* Lakehouse architecture \& ETL/ELT design
* Multi\-tenant data models \& embedded analytics

**Engineering Practices**

* CI/CD for data pipelines and BI assets
* Write reusable, modular, maintainable and testable code.
* Monitoring and data quality practices
* Version control (e.g., Git)

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Azure infrastructure knowledge (IAM, networking)
* Data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations)

**Mindset**

* Strong ownership and autonomy: You take full ownership of outcomes, not just tasks
* Impact\-driven: You focus on real\-world results and have strong intuition for identifying patterns, anomalies, and optimization opportunities
* Product thinker: You connect data to user value and turn raw data into clear, actionable insights
* Proactive: You proactively identify opportunities, validate ideas, and build reports, dashboards, and analyses without waiting for requirements.
* Domain expert: You understand business contexts quickly and translate problems into effective data solutions.
* Pragmatic: You prioritize simplicity and avoid overengineering, focusing on what delivers value.
* Clear communicator: You communicate effectively across technical and business stakeholders, making complex topics easy to understand.

#### **Language**


Min. English C1

#### **Expected travel needs**


2 annual one\-week team events

#### **Our Tech Stack**

* C\# (.NET 8–10\), ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core
* Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Blob Storage
* Azure App Services \& Functions, Docker
* Azure Service Bus, Terraform
* GitHub Actions, SonarQube, extensive unit \& integration tests
* Angular Latest Version
* Databricks and Azure Fabric

#### **Hiring Process**

* Recruiter Screen (45 mins)
* Interview with the Hiring Manager (1 hour)
* Technical interview (1 hour)
* Discussion with founder(s) and peer(s) (1 hour)

 **LimeFlight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.**


We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work.


Join us and be part of a team committed to shaping a zero\-waste future for aviation, where your ideas and passion truly matter.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Join CERN's Vacuum, Surfaces and Coatings Group and contribute to engineering projects supporting the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) experiments.


As a Mechanical Engineer in the Experimental Vacuum team, you will work on the design, development, production and testing of ultra\-high vacuum equipment around the ATLAS, ALICE, CMS and LHCb experiments.


You will take part in projects from initial engineering concepts through design, simulation and prototyping to testing, installation and operational follow\-up. Working alongside engineers, technicians and specialists from other disciplines, you will gain hands\-on experience with complex mechanical systems in a unique scientific environment.

**Your responsibilities**

* Design and develop precision mechanical equipment for ultra\-high vacuum applications.
* Create 3D CAD models and perform structural, thermal and modal analyses to validate designs.
* Follow projects through design, prototyping, manufacturing, assembly and testing.
* Plan and carry out laboratory tests, including leak detection, residual gas analysis and vacuum performance measurements.
* Work with CERN workshops, suppliers and technical teams to support production and quality control.
* Contribute to the installation, commissioning and improvement of vacuum equipment for the LHC experiments.
* Collaborate across engineering disciplines to solve technical challenges and deliver reliable solutions.

**Your profile**

* Mechanical design and CAD (CATIA, Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks or similar).
* Engineering simulation and analysis (ANSYS or similar).
* Precision mechanics, manufacturing, assembly or testing.
* Vacuum technology or laboratory environments.
* Experience with ultra\-high vacuum systems, leak detection or residual gas analysis is an advantage, but you do not need experience in all these areas.


Skills

* Good foundation in mechanical engineering and design.
* Interest in developing expertise in ultra\-high vacuum and precision engineering.
* Practical, curious and solution\-oriented approach.

jobs.title: FDE - Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Your role**
-------------

At Kyndryl, **Forward Deployed Engineers work where data, cloud, and AI become real** . This is not a traditional consulting role or a back\-office engineering position. Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customers to design, build, and deploy modern data solutions that operate in complex, regulated, production environments.


As a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) – Data Engineering \& GCP** , you will own defined delivery workstreams within customer engagements, designing and building scalable data platforms, pipelines, and data products primarily on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** .


You will operate with growing independence in customer environments, combining strong hands\-on Data Engineering expertise with business context. You will translate ambiguous business and data challenges into robust, production\-ready solutions, from rapid prototypes and MVPs through industrialization and production deployment.


The role sits at the intersection of **Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, AI enablement, consulting, and delivery accountability** . You will work across the data lifecycle—from ingestion and transformation to orchestration, governance, observability, and data serving—creating trusted data foundations for analytics, operational workloads, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.


You will use modern engineering and AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate solution design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment, while building the customer trust required to drive adoption and long\-term impact.


**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Customer Engagement \& Solution Engineering:** Partner directly with customers to understand business and data challenges and translate them into high\-quality, fit\-for\-purpose technical solutions, balancing delivery speed with scalability, maintainability, security, and long\-term architectural integrity.
* **Data Engineering on GCP:** Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and data platforms using technologies such as **BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer/Airflow, and Dataform** , selecting the right services and patterns for each workload.
* **Data Architecture \& Modernization:** Contribute to the design and implementation of modern cloud data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouse patterns, batch and streaming processing, and migrations from legacy or on\-premises data platforms to GCP.
* **Rapid Prototyping:** Build and iterate PoCs, MVPs, and production\-oriented prototypes to validate architecture decisions, integration patterns, performance, and business value quickly with real customer data and environments.
* **Ownership, Deployment \& Partnership:** Own delivery workstreams end to end—from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production stabilization. Work as part of the customer team rather than operating only as an external advisor.
* **Data Integration \& Processing:** Implement robust batch and real\-time ingestion, transformation, and processing patterns across heterogeneous data sources, APIs, databases, files, event streams, and enterprise platforms.
* **Production Engineering:** Build solutions with production requirements in mind, including **CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, monitoring, observability, security, IAM, data quality, lineage, and operational supportability** .
* **Performance \& Cost Optimization:** Troubleshoot and optimize data workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost, particularly across BigQuery, Spark/Dataproc, Dataflow, and other GCP data services.
* **AI \& ML Data Enablement:** Build and integrate the data foundations required for Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions, including reliable data pipelines, feature preparation, data quality, vector and unstructured data processing, and integration with GCP AI services such as **Vertex AI** .
* **Field Intelligence:** Systematically capture deployment learnings, reusable patterns, technical accelerators, and best practices from customer engagements and share them across Kyndryl engineering and delivery teams.
* **Continuous Learning:** Stay current with the evolving GCP data ecosystem, modern Data Engineering practices, AI\-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies, applying new capabilities pragmatically to customer problems.
* **Platform \& Engineering Contribution:** Contribute reusable code, reference architectures, automation, frameworks, and feedback that improve Kyndryl’s Data \& AI engineering capabilities and accelerate future customer engagements.

  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python, (or another modern language such as C\#, Node.js or TypeScript); experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus •Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git \& GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark •Cloud \& Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures Preferred skills and experience •Open\-Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community\-driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories •T\-shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting •Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi\-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms •Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) \& Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions •Performance \& Security: Knowledge of system\-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems •Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences •Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required •Education: Degree\-level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline \- or equivalent professional experience  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud-Native, AI-Driven Platform)
jobs.description:
**Descripción de la empresa**  

Septeo es un actor europeo líder en el sector del software con presencia internacional, reconocido como uno de los cinco principales proveedores de software vertical en Francia. En plena fase de rápido crecimiento y transformación constante, el grupo se ha consolidado como un referente en la industria del software, impulsado por la fortaleza de unos equipos decididos, audaces y comprometidos.


En Septeo, la inteligencia artificial es el eje de nuestra evolución. La entendemos como un motor de rendimiento sostenible, colaboración e innovación, integrada de manera responsable en las prácticas cotidianas y democratizada en todas nuestras áreas de negocio. Nuestra ambición es clara: «crear software inteligente para Europa».


Nuestra cultura se cimenta en valores sólidos: ser, hacer y transformar juntos. No es una cultura estática; se vive día a día en nuestras acciones y decisiones, logrando un equilibrio entre rendimiento, responsabilidad y disfrute.


Esta ambición se refleja en nuestra labor diaria: diseñar software que acompaña los momentos esenciales de la vida, al servicio de millones de ciudadanos. Desempeñar un papel en estos momentos clave conlleva una gran responsabilidad. Es una responsabilidad que asumimos con orgullo y que pronto podría ser también la tuya.


Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.

 **Descripción del empleo**  

We are building the next generation of AI\-native software for the hospitality industry. Our platform powers complex, multi\-tenant environments across multiple companies and product lines, operating in high\-availability, high\-performance scenarios.


Our systems handle critical operational workflows where uptime, scalability, and security are non\-negotiable. As we evolve toward AI\-native capabilities and intelligent automation, our infrastructure must be resilient, observable, and ready to scale dynamically.


We believe DevOps is not a support function — it is a core engineering discipline that enables product velocity, reliability, and innovation.


If you enjoy designing robust infrastructure, automating everything, and building platforms that engineers love to use, we’d love to meet you.

**How You’ll Have Impact**

* **Build the Platform Behind the Platform**: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi\-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
* **Enable Engineering Velocity**: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
* **Drive Reliability \& Observability**: Ensure high availability, performance, and real\-time visibility across distributed systems.
* **Architect for Scale**: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
* **Champion Infrastructure as Code**: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
* **Embed Security by Design**: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in **AWS and/or Azure**.
* Manage and optimize containerized workloads using **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (**Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI** or equivalent).
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
* Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (**ELK stack**, **Grafana** dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
* Operate, monitor, and tune **Microsoft SQL Server** databases (performance, backups, high availability).
* Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers (**Java / Kotlin, C\#, Node.js**) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
* Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tooling (**Claude, Codex**, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.


You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

**Cloud Building Blocks: AWS \& Azure**


We run workloads on **both AWS and Azure**. We are looking for solid hands\-on experience with **IaaS** and core managed cloud services on at least one of them — knowing the equivalent on the other cloud is a strong plus. These are the building blocks you’ll work with:

* **Virtual machines \& autoscaling** — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets \| AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
* **Virtual networking** — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints \| AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
* **L7 load balancing \+ WAF** — Azure: Application Gateway \+ WAF \| AWS: Application Load Balancer \+ AWS WAF
* **Web app / API hosting** — Azure: App Service \| AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
* **Managed Kubernetes** — Azure: AKS \| AWS: EKS
* **Message queues** — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues \| AWS: Amazon SQS
* **Object storage** — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs \| AWS: Amazon S3
* **In\-memory cache** — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis \| AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
* **Managed SQL Server** — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance \| AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
* **Workload identity (secretless auth)** — Azure: Managed Identity \+ DefaultAzureCredential \| AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) \+ SDK default credential chain
* **Secrets \& keys** — Azure: Key Vault \| AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
* **Transactional email** — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) \| AWS: Amazon SES
* **Per\-environment configuration** — Azure: App Settings \| AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
* **Logs, metrics \& alerts** — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor \| AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
* **Runtime diagnostics** — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics \| AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

  

**Requisitos**  

* 5\+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **AWS or Azure** — experience with both is a strong plus.
* Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with **production experience in Kubernetes** (required).
* Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
* Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft SQL Server** (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
* Experience with **Redis** in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
* Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
* Experience working in high\-availability SaaS environments.
* Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including **Grafana** dashboards and alerting.
* Automation\-first mindset.
* Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
* **Languages**: fluent **Spanish** and professional **English** (both required).


We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands\-on experience with **at least one technology in each area**: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers \& orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases \& caching.

**Nice\-to\-Have Superpowers**

* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
* Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
* Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
* Experience in multi\-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with **both AWS and Azure**.
* Scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* **French** — a huge plus (we can dream!).

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* High ownership and architectural impact.
* Cloud\-native SaaS platform with real scale challenges.
* Opportunity to shape infrastructure evolution toward AI\-native capabilities.
* Cross\-functional, product\-driven engineering culture.
* International environment with technical autonomy.

  

**Información adicional**  

* Participar en la aventura AI First de Septeo y descubrir nuevas formas de trabajar gracias a la inteligencia artificial.
* Crecer y desarrollarse gracias a un itinerario de formación personalizado y a oportunidades de movilidad interna.
* Vivir una experiencia humana, intercambiar y compartir en eventos temáticos como encuentros afterwork, actividades deportivas, iniciativas de RSC, seminarios y mucho más.
* Unirse a un equipo que cuida de los demás y se compromete con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la inclusión.

* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems, services, and APIs

* Build service layers and reusable components that can support multiple products and use cases
* Design and optimize database schemas, queries, indexing, and data models

**AI \& Integrations**


* Integrate AI models, tools, and APIs into existing products and backend workflows
* Build reliable interfaces between backend systems and external AI providers
* Design end\-to\-end AI\-enabled workflows connecting AI services with databases, APIs, backend systems, and product logic
* Evaluate opportunities to use AI to improve product capabilities, workflows, and automation


**Collaboration \& Engineering Practices**


* Work closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Infrastructure, and other functions to deliver new features and products
* Participate in technical planning, architecture reviews, and code reviews
* Communicate technical risks, trade\-offs, and solutions clearly
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, system maintainability, and overall technical quality

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building reliable and scalable backend systems that perform effectively as our products and user base grow
* Designing backend services and APIs that are maintainable, reusable, and able to support multiple products
* Maintaining strong system reliability, performance, and uptime in live production environments
* Identifying and resolving production issues, bottlenecks, and scaling challenges effectively
* Building practical AI integrations and workflows that add value to our products and internal systems
* Making thoughtful technical and architectural decisions that support both immediate and long\-term needs
* Contributing to stronger engineering practices, monitoring, reliability, and operational processes

* Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining backend systems in production
* Proven experience working on live systems, products, or platforms serving a large number of users
* Experience operating or supporting production environments as part of LiveOps, platform operations, or continuous product operations
* Hands\-on experience integrating AI tools, models, LLMs, or AI APIs into production systems and building practical solutions on top of them
* Ability to design and implement end\-to\-end AI\-enabled workflows connecting AI services with backend systems, databases, APIs, and product logic
* Strong understanding of backend architecture, distributed systems, API design, databases, caching, concurrency, scalability, performance optimization, and system reliability
* Strong experience with at least one backend language or framework such as Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, Java, or C\#

* Experience building REST APIs and service\-based architectures
* Experience with Redis or similar caching technologies
* Experience with message queues, workers, or event\-driven systems
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs and external services
* Experience working with cloud\-based production environments
* Hands\-on experience dealing with production challenges such as traffic spikes, service degradation, incidents, database bottlenecks, scaling, and uptime
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
* Able to take ownership of backend systems and technical problems from development through production
* Experience working with backend systems for mobile games, consumer apps, or other high\-scale products is a plus

Our commitment to respect, transparency, and simplicity means you can trust us to always choose to do the right thing.



As a trusted partner for purpose\-built AI and intelligent automation, we solve highly complex problems for our enterprise customers and put their information to work to transform the way they do business. Over 10,000 customers trust ABBYY, including many Fortune 500 ones. You will work on further developing a portfolio already containing client names such as DHL, Johnson \& Johnson, FDA, DMV, PwC, KeyBank, Spotify, and H\&R BLOCK.

**About the role:**



ABBYY Vantage is our flagship Document AI platform – a cloud\-native, microservices\-based product that combines purpose\-built AI, OCR, NLP, and direct LLM integration to help enterprise customers extract, classify, and act on data from any document. Vantage 3\.0, our latest release, introduces native Azure OpenAI integration, enterprise\-grade compliance and redaction, a real\-time analytics dashboard, and a growing library of pre\-configured AI skills. Over 10,000 customers trust ABBYY – including Fortune 500 companies like DHL, Johnson \& Johnson, FDA, PwC, KeyBank, Spotify, and H\&R Block – to automate their most complex document workflows.



We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to serve as a senior technical leader on the Vantage platform. You will drive the design and delivery of complex, cross\-cutting capabilities – spanning document AI pipelines, LLM integrations, compliance infrastructure, analytics, and platform extensibility. Beyond your own code, you will act as a technical multiplier: influencing architectural decisions, setting quality standards, and developing the engineers around you. This is a role for someone who leads through depth, judgment, and impact.


**Job Responsibilities:**


* **Technical Leadership:** Drive the technical design and delivery of significant Vantage platform capabilities, from architecture and API contracts through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* **Quality \& Standards:** Define and uphold engineering standards for the Vantage codebase – covering code quality, service reliability, performance, security, and compliance – and drive their adoption across teams.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** Act as a senior technical voice in cross\-functional planning with product management, ML engineering, cloud architecture, and engineering leadership; translate business priorities into actionable technical roadmaps.
* **Platform Improvement:** Lead initiatives to improve Vantage platform health at scale: service decomposition, observability, CI/CD maturity, and developer productivity.
* **Operational Excellence:** Own high\-severity incident response for Vantage cloud services; drive post\-mortems and systemic reliability improvements.
* **Engineering Mentorship:** Mentor Senior and Principal Engineers on the Vantage team; build a culture of technical rigor, shared ownership, and continuous learning.
* **Technical Innovation:** Evaluate and champion adoption of new technologies – from GenAI model integrations to cloud\-native tooling – that strengthen ABBYY's Document AI differentiation.


**Job Requirements:**


* 10–13 years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise in C\+\+
* Demonstrated ability to work with multiple programming languages, and willingness to work with both C\# .NET and C\+\+
* Proven experience designing, implementing, and operating CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, and deploying workflows using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps Pipelines
* Strong command of microservices architecture, distributed system design, and cloud\-native patterns at enterprise scale
* Demonstrated ability to mentor Senior and Mid\-level Engineers and partner with Engineering Managers on technical direction
* Experience leading technical design reviews and influencing architectural decisions across team and product boundaries


**Desired Qualifications**


* Experience in cloud, preferably using Microsoft Azure (AKS, Storage, Key Vaults, Azure SQL or equivalent)
* Track record of delivering production\-grade systems that meet enterprise compliance, security, and reliability standards
* Hands\-on experience designing and operating workflow\-driven systems (orchestration, retries, timeouts, and state management)
* Experience integrating Machine Learning, Neural Networks or LLMs into enterprise applications and workflows
* Comfort operating across a globally distributed engineering organization spanning multiple regions and cultures

  


**Salary Range:**



The anticipated base salary range for this position is between **25,000,000 HUF and 26,000,000 HUF annually**. Base salary ranges may vary by geographic location and relevant experience, education, certifications, and seniority compared to others performing substantially similar work. There is no guarantee that an offer will be at the top of the posted range, as compensation decisions are based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, qualifications, and internal equity.

  


**Here are some of our local benefits:**



* Medical benefits after 90 days
* SZÉP Card allowance for recreational activities
* Volunteering Time Off (VTO)
* Company paid sick time up to 10 days per year


\#LI\-MM1



**Join ABBYY, and you will:**


**Love how you work**



* We provide remote and hybrid working options to fit all lifestyles.
* We use flexible hours across most of our teams to allow you to find your own definition of balance.
* Encouraging a culture of giving, we provide two paid volunteering days off every year so you can take time to contribute to the causes you care about.
* To ensure your family is cared for, we offer paid parental leave in all our locations.


**Love whom you work with**



* We are a global team of 600\+ colleagues, spread across 15 countries on four continents.
* With colleagues representing 30\+ nationalities, our workforce reflects the world.
* Innovation and excellence run through our veins. Our teams gather the expertise which has garnered ABBYY more than 140 technology patents.
* We are guided by the values of respect, transparency, and simplicity.
* "Team Environment" is in the top three highest\-scoring drivers of engagement across all of our departments.


**Love what you work on**


* We are a company with more than 35 years of experience in the technology market;
* Over 10,000 customers trust ABBYY, including many Fortune 500 ones, with names such as DHL, Johnson \& Johnson, FDA, DMV, PwC, KeyBank, Spotify, and H\&R BLOCK;

* Our Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision Technologies, and a marketplace built with AI, can transform any document in any process;
* Top Analyst firms recognize ABBYY's market leadership, including Gartner, Everest PEAK Matrix ® Assessment, ISG Intelligent Automation Lens, and NelsonHall, amongst others.

jobs.description:
**Job Dimensions**:


The Global Solutions Developer is in the HWS Information Systems group and will work closely with many functional groups within the HWS business, including manufacturing, supply chain, quality and finance to design and deliver solutions in alignment with the HWS global strategic direction. The primary responsibility of this role is for functional application design and deployment of new and modified solutions for ad\-hoc application modules globally that fit the need(s) of the business.

* Comply with all local, corporate and regulatory environmental, health and safety protocols and procedures at Howmet facilities and non\-Howmet operations where we have IT infrastructure.
* Ensure IT staff and contractors that are performing IT work also adhere to these rules.
* Bachelor’s Degree (in an IT or Engineering related field) from an accredited institution
* Eagerness to learn
* Strong attention to detail
* Time management with the ability to balance multiple tasks and meet project deadlines
* Excellent problem solving, collaboration, and analytical skills
* Experience in full\-stack development and other software development projects
* Experience working within Microsoft Visual Studio
* Experience in SQL, Python, C\#, JavaScript

 **Preferred Qualifications**:

* Experience working within Microsoft Visual Studio
* Experience in SQL, Python, C\#, JavaScript

jobs.title: Tech Cell Engineer Level II - Light Maintenance Production Control Center
jobs.description:
### **General Information**


Ref \#
237115
Location
Qatar\-Doha
Job family
Engineering
* Closing Date: 2026\-10\-05
  

  

### **Description**


**About the role**


Facilitate the review, evaluation, and distribution of system\-related activities and tasks across Line Production Control, Light Maintenance Production Control Center (PCC), and Heavy Maintenance Control Center (HMCC) Tech Cell, ensuring effective coordination, technical compliance, resource optimization, and timely maintenance execution.


**Operational Accountabilities;**


Light Maintenance Production Control Center


* Evaluating incoming Deferred Defects (DDs), Troubleshooting Recommendations (TSRs), and Technical Cell support requests from Line Maintenance, Quality Engineering, and other operational stakeholders.
* Reviewing Aircraft Maintenance Pre\-Input Packages to identify and highlight system\-critical tasks, modifications, and operational risks while ensuring compliance with allocated Turnaround Time (TAT) requirements.
* Assessing first\-time and complex aircraft maintenance tasks prior to work acceptance to verify the availability of required manpower, materials, spare parts, tooling, equipment, and logistics support.
* Supporting Production Planning by providing technical reviews, task card amendment recommendations, and feasibility assessments for complex tasks, major modifications, and first\-time maintenance activities.
* Coordinating with Production Planning and Engineering teams to ensure the availability of approved engineering documentation, serviceable equipment, required tools, and aircraft parts before maintenance execution.
* Monitoring, analyzing, and recommending troubleshooting solutions for recurrent and critical aircraft system defects to improve reliability and maintenance effectiveness.
* Conducting pre\-induction briefings for Shift Managers and Supervisors on Deferred Defects (DDs), Troubleshooting Recommendations (TSRs), critical system issues, and pre\-arrival/pre\-dock maintenance requirements.
* Communicating lessons learned, system challenges, and maintenance events from previous aircraft inputs to mitigate risks and support effective planning for upcoming maintenance activities.
* Analyzing current and historical aircraft maintenance data, including modifications, major rectifications, and critical defects, to support case studies, reliability improvements, and future maintenance planning.
* Supporting continuous operational improvement and performing additional departmental duties as assigned by the Head of Department.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**


Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future, and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
  

Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.


Together, everything is possible.


### **Qualification**


**About You**


* Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent with Minimum 7 plus years of job\-related experience.

**Essential:**


* Minimum of 02 years' experience in Production as a Licensed Aircraft Engineer (EN.01\) and holds a company authorization for QR Fleet Type Rating
* Degree (B. Eng., BSc in Engineering discipline) or hold an ICAO type Il License.
* General Knowledge of Aircraft Systems, Maintenance Environment constraints.
* Good knowledge of aircraft maintenance data
* Knowledge of Part M and and Part\-145 Regulations and functions.
* Project management and execution
* Excellent decision\-making skills \- Ability to take correct decisions keeping in view all the constraints within relatively short period of time.
* Strong\-analytical skills to handle complex operational situations.
* Proven ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Efficient in time management and above average ability to prioritize tasks.
* Willingness to work or assist operations team outside normal working hours.
* Excellent communication skill (speak/read/write) in English.
* Good background in using Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). Good technical report writing skills
* Managerial skills \- Ability to delegate work, set clear direction and manage workflow. Strong mentoring and coaching skills. Ability to train and develop subordinate's skills. Ability to foster teamwork among team members.

**Preferred:**


* Any additional courses related to Aircraft Maintenance Planning, LEAN Fundamentals, and Safety Management System.
* Proof of involvement in any process improvement exercise within Production
* Ability to communicate technical information to the sections inside technical department.
* Good knowledge of IT System(s) being used in Planning.

So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination.


Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community.

If you have what it takes to be part of our 5\-star team, please take the first step and apply now by uploading your CV and completing the online application.

### **Description**

This role is expected to Architect, design and implement cloud based big data analytics solutions which are dynamic, scalable, fault tolerant, secure and reliable. Responsible for creating and maintaining an enterprise self\-service cloud data platform and architecture, involving building reference architectures, technical blueprints and accelerators for data product team. The role is pivotal in translating business requirements into effective data solutions encompassing both data engineering and business intelligence, developing data models, defining data architecture, and ensuring data integrity, security, scalability and performance aligned with specific project or program needs

  

**Your duties would include:**


* Ensure to create and align a technical blueprint for cloud data analytics strategy with organization's technology roadmap. Additionally, ensure that the work program adheres to the defined blueprint.
* Work closely with other data architects to foster collaboration, create synergies in solutions and establish standardized tools and technologies.
* Design and develop robust, scalable and high\-performance self\-serve data platform that empowers data product engineers to build data products as well as data analysts and business users to access and analyse data without the need for extensive technical expertise.
* Create and maintain reference and solution architecture blueprints.
* Ensure data security, compliance and governance best practices are implemented across the data platform.
* Select and implement appropriate technologies for the self\-serve data platform, including tools for data ingestion, orchestration, storage \& transformation.
* Leveraging strong business acumen, translate business requirements to create solution artefacts to build data solutions.
* Select appropriate technologies and tools offered by organisations' self\-serve data platform for building the data solutions that are secure and cost effective.
* Generate specifications for BI architecture and other design artefacts that illustrate the approach and impact of proposed solutions.
* Facilitate technical and business sessions required to align the solution architecture, encompassing both data engineering and business intelligence, with business and technology objectives throughout the development life cycle.
* Design and develop enterprise\-level big data models to effectively organize and manage massive datasets.
* Design, develop and maintain scalable big data architectures and enterprise models for organisation's big data warehouse, ensuring optimal performance and manage massive datasets.
* Assess existing data architectures, identify areas for improvement, and provide strategic recommendations.
* Implement metadata management practices to catalogue and track data assets across the organization.
* Monitor, analyse and optimize data platform services and data solutions.
* Stay up\-to\-date on the latest cloud data platform technologies.
* Maintain knowledge of emerging technologies and architectures and lead proof of concepts.

Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. * Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with Minimum 6 years of job\-related experience

Essential


* 6\+ years of experience Big Data, Data Warehouse, Data Analytics projects, with at least 3 years in Data Architect role
* Prior experience building large scale enterprise data architectures using commercial and/or open source Data Analytics technologies
* Prior experience building large scale enterprise big data models

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer .NET | C# | Azure
jobs.description:
Description
**Full\-Stack Software Engineer .NET \| C\# \| Azure**
======================================================

**About Us**
------------

  

We are a mobility provider based in Luxembourg, operating public transport, shuttles and on\-demand services across the region. Our Digital Factory builds products that help the people behind these services work more effectively.


You will join the Foundry, our small software development team. We bring different areas of expertise, enjoy solving problems together and make time to help each other. We value the way people listen, learn and collaborate as much as the technical knowledge they bring.

**About Our Digital Transformation**
------------------------------------

  

We are modernising the applications and systems that support our operations, with C\#, .NET and Azure at the heart of our software environment and Microsoft Fabric supporting our data foundation.


You will contribute to a varied portfolio of digital products addressing operational and business challenges across the organisation. For example, we are building applications that help teams understand and improve workshop workflows, from welcoming a vehicle and organising maintenance to following work through to completion. We are also developing tools to analyse kilometres travelled without passengers, combining vehicle telemetry, reconciliation of planned and actual journeys, calculation logic and clear user interfaces to help teams investigate differences and identify potential savings.


These are two examples among a broader and evolving portfolio. Our products can combine operational workflows, user\-facing applications, system integrations and live or frequently updated vehicle data. This can include location, energy consumption, vehicle condition and other telemetry generated by a connected fleet. The work offers opportunities to solve problems across several technical dimensions and different areas of the business.

**About Your Role**
-------------------

  

You will design, build and improve digital products across the full stack, from user interfaces to backend services, APIs and application databases. Your work will include developing features used directly by operational teams, connecting existing systems and improving the reliability and usability of our applications.


You will also contribute to the shared technical foundations behind these products. This may include reusable services, integration patterns and common components that make future applications easier to build, connect and maintain. The role combines visible product development with deeper engineering work that can benefit several solutions across the organisation.


Understanding the business problem is part of the job. Working with Product Owners, Business Analysts and operational colleagues, you will explore how people work, clarify requirements and help shape practical solutions. You will consider how a change affects the wider workflow, its users and the systems around it, looking for the simplest approach that addresses the underlying need.


You will take ownership of agreed work through development, testing, deployment and production follow\-up, with responsibilities suited to your experience. Our Tech Lead and colleagues will support you through code reviews, pairing and regular technical discussions.


You will have access to approved AI tools to support development, learning and exploration. We encourage you to think carefully about what can be delegated to AI, where human judgement is needed and how to verify the results. You remain responsible for understanding and testing what you deliver.

**About You**
-------------

  

You approach problems with curiosity and initiative. You want to understand why something is needed and are willing to investigate, ask questions and suggest options when requirements leave room for interpretation. You can move work forward independently while recognising when to seek guidance or validate an assumption.


You listen actively and take other people’s perspectives seriously. You bring humility to technical discussions, feel comfortable acknowledging what you do not know and can change your mind when new information reveals a better approach. You communicate progress and difficulties openly, and enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues.


You have hands\-on experience building applications with C\# and .NET. You are familiar with web interfaces, APIs, SQL and application databases, Git, testing and debugging, and care about building software that is secure, maintainable and reliable.


Hands\-on Azure experience is required. Familiarity with a modern frontend framework, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices would be useful.


We welcome earlier\-career candidates who meet the core C\#, .NET and Azure requirements and demonstrate sound foundations, thoughtful problem\-solving and a willingness to learn. You do not need to know every technology on day one. We want to understand how you think, work with others and develop your skills.


English is required. French and German are welcome advantages, but neither is required.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

  

Within your first year, you will have contributed useful and reliable features to our operational products and developed a strong understanding of the workflows they support. Your work will help users complete tasks more easily, understand operational issues and make better\-informed decisions.


You will have contributed to both user\-facing applications and the shared foundations behind them. You will identify gaps before they become problems, explain your technical choices and help the team find solutions that make sense across the wider system.


You will grow into greater technical ownership at a pace suited to your experience, contribute constructively to team discussions and build trust through dependable delivery, curiosity and collaboration.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

  

We take onboarding seriously. We will spend time introducing you to the business, the products and the people you will work with. You will learn how the team operates, who to speak with and where to find support, allowing you to build context and confidence as you take on greater responsibility.


You will join colleagues who make time to explain, discuss difficult problems and share feedback respectfully. There is room to contribute ideas, ask questions, experiment and learn from one another.


This is a permanent position where you can work on applications used in everyday transport operations, connected vehicle data and technical foundations that support several products. You will see how your work affects people’s time, the quality of their decisions and the reliability of the services they provide.


If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving problems across systems and building useful products with people who care about the outcome, we would be happy to meet you.


Languages English Education Master

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer III, Programming Foundations
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join the Programming Foundations Team within Amazon Builder Experience as a Software Development Engineer. The Language Experience team in Builder Tools is the center of excellence for Amazon's use of programming languages, highly\-leveraged shared software, and application build tools.  

  

Our tools are used in all aspects of the business, and their care and evolution are of critical importance to the effectiveness of Amazon. We're looking for a deeply technical leader interested in sustaining and evolving the shared software platform used by nearly every service within the company. Those with experience evolving broadly distributed and highly complex software libraries, such as large open source projects and mission critical foundational software stacks will be given an opportunity to have company wide impact.  

Amazon Builder Experience is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will design and build developer tools that Amazon engineers use every day. You will work with the languages and libraries that power Amazon's services, making them easier to use and more reliable. You will help maintain our build tools, compilers and package managers. You will work on our 3PSW repository mirrors. You will collaborate with engineers across Amazon to understand their pain points and build tools that address them. You will write code, review code from teammates, and help others debug issues with our tools.  

  

A day in the life  

Your work will directly affect how builders at Amazon do their jobs. We are a language expertise team at the heart of being able to compile and shift software. This is practical work that requires understanding what builders actually need and building tools that solve their problems without getting in the way.  

  

About the team  

The Programming Foundations Team is part of Amazon Builder Experience. We work on the basic tools and infrastructure that builders use to write software. Our team includes engineers who care about developer experience and want to make building software at Amazon easier. We do not own customer\-facing products directly, but our work affects every team that builds software at Amazon. We focus on doing useful work rather than flashy projects. If you like building tools that help other engineers and want to work on problems that span the whole company, this team might be a good fit.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience in development in the last 3 years

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
