* € 4\.223,\- en € 6\.033,\-
* HBO
* 40 uur


  
* ### **Wat ga je doen?**

#### **Met jouw energie kan het**


	+ Je combineert technische diepgang met overzicht en zorgt dat complexe hoogspanningsprojecten beheerst en volgens afspraak door de engineering lopen.
	+ Je verbindt bouw, primaire en secundaire techniek en hebt daarmee zicht op het hele engineeringsproces.
	+ Je kunt rekenen op een goed salaris, 28,7% flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden en volop ruimte voor jouw ontwikkeling.
Als Expert Engineer secundaire techniek hoogspanning in Weert houd jij overzicht over de engineering van complexe hoogspanningsprojecten. Je verbindt disciplines, bewaakt voortgang en kwaliteit en ziet risico’s voordat ze een project vertragen. Met jouw technische expertise help je projecten én collega\-engineers verder.

#### **Zo ga jij de uitdaging aan**


In deze rol zit je midden in de engineering van onze hoogspanningsprojecten. Je weet wat er speelt binnen de standaarden van secundaire techniek en doorleeft deze helemaal. Jij weet als geen ander kennis over te dragen en Project Engineers te begeleiden en op te leiden in de projecten. Jij brengt de techniek en de mens bij elkaar. Je kijkt vooruit, maakt knelpunten bespreekbaar en zorgt dat planning, reviews en technische keuzes op elkaar aansluiten. Tegelijk deel je jouw expertise met engineers en help je hen groeien in kennis en vakmanschap.


Dit zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden:


	+ Je hebt kennis van beveiligingen en automatiseringen binnen de hoogspanningswereld. Je bent didactisch goed onderlegd en weet je kennis over te dragen aan andere collega’s.
	+ Je onderhoudt en beschrijft onze standaarden; dit is het fundament van de engineeringswerkzaamheden.
	+ Je houdt overzicht over de engineering binnen projecten en zorgt voor een goede afstemming tussen bouw, primaire en secundaire techniek. Je begeleidt de projectengineers met het opstellen van de engineeringsplanning, bewaakt de voortgang en anticipeert op risico’s en mogelijke verstoringen.
	+ Je reviewt projectplannen en borgt dat belangrijke reviewmomenten tijdig en zorgvuldig plaatsvinden. Je begeleidt engineers inhoudelijk, deelt kennis en helpt mee om kwaliteit, veiligheid en vakmanschap binnen de afdeling verder te versterken.
	+ Het hoogspanningsstation kan nooit uitgeschakeld worden en het afbreukrisico is hoog. Daardoor review je alle tekeningen samen met de Project Engineer voordat deze naar buiten gaan. Het afbreukrisico is immers zeer hoog.
* ### **Functie\-eisen**

#### **Zo pak jij het aan**


Jij houdt het hoofd koel als meerdere projecten, disciplines en belangen samenkomen. Je ziet snel waar risico’s ontstaan, stelt de juiste vragen en wacht niet af wanneer actie nodig is. Daarbij communiceer je helder, werk je gemakkelijk samen met verschillende vakgebieden en weet je anderen mee te nemen in keuzes en verbeteringen.


Verder heb je:


	+ Hbo\-niveau in een technische richting, bijvoorbeeld elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde, of technische bedrijfskunde.
	+ Meer dan 6 jaar relevante ervaring binnen engineering en projectbeheersing.
	+ Kennis van hoog\- en middenspanningsinfrastructuur en ruime kennis van projectmanagement en engineeringsprocessen in deze branche.
* ### **Team \& cultuur**

#### **Je zet je schouders eronder met …**


Jouw collega’s binnen Engineering \& Realisatie. Samen met je collega Expert Engineers van Secundair werk je in een omgeving waarin technische expertise, samenwerking en vernieuwing samenkomen. Met collega Experts, Projectmanagers, Project Engineers, Detail Engineers en specialisten werk je aan de uitbreiding en aanpassing van hoogspanningsinstallaties. We delen kennis, zoeken actief de samenwerking op en zorgen samen dat projecten veilig en beheerst gerealiseerd kunnen worden.


Vanuit Weert werk je aan projecten waarin de nieuwste bouw\- en ontwerptechnieken samenkomen met hoge eisen aan veiligheid en kwaliteit. Voor cyberveiligheid engineer je volgens de opdracht van de opdrachtgever en volgens de geldende standaarden. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten én over te dragen, zodat niet alleen projecten maar ook collega\-engineers verder groeien.


We vinden het belangrijk dat je je bij ons thuis voelt. We zijn allemaal anders en het mooie daarvan is dat we elkaar vanuit die verschillen aanvullen. We hebben elkaars perspectieven en meningen nodig voor een succesvolle energietransitie! Lees hier mee over ons beleid op diversiteit en inclusie.
* ### **Wat krijg je van ons?**

#### **En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou**


Bij Enexis werk je in de voorhoede van een van de grootste uitdagingen van onze tijd: de energietransitie. Daarbij zorgen we goed voor je. Dat begint met een uitgebreid welkomstpakket en \-programma om je collega’s te leren kennen. En met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden:


	+ Salaris in schaal 15 tussen € 4\.223 en € 6\.033 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur per week. Inclusief de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden kan je salaris oplopen tot € 7\.764,\- bruto per maand.
	+ Boven op je salaris ontvang je 28,7% aan flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: 8% vakantiegeld, 10,7% dertiende maand en 10% persoonlijk budget. Je kunt dit laten uitbetalen of inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld extra verlofdagen.
	+ Een bijdrage van 70% aan je ABP Keuzepensioen.
	+ 24,5 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. Met je persoonlijk budget en dertiende maand koop je tot wel 35,5 extra verlofdagen.
	+ Een laptop of tablet en smartphone die je ook privé mag gebruiken.
	+ Reiskostenvergoeding en een eersteklas openbaarvervoerabonnement voor zakelijk gebruik.
	+ Een vitaliteitsbudget van € 700,\- voor bijvoorbeeld een sportabonnement, je hobby of het verduurzamen van je huis.
	+ Ruimte om te groeien via ons interne ontwikkelplatform en externe opleidingen en trainingen.
Werk als Expert Engineer Secundaire techniek Hoogspanning aan het energienetwerk van morgen

Goed om te weten


	+ Na je sollicitatie ontvang je een e\-mail met meer informatie over de procedure. Meestal bestaat deze uit twee gesprekken: een eerste (online) gesprek met de teammanager en een Expert Engineer, waarbij de recruiter eventueel aansluit, en een tweede gesprek met je toekomstige collega’s op locatie.

Bij Enexis draag je niet alleen bij aan een betere wereld, maar bouw je ook aan je eigen toekomst. We dragen namelijk 70% bij aan je ABP Keuzepensioen.### **Thuiswerken en apparatuur**

===========================================================


Albert stuurt met veel plezier NPM aan, de afdeling die een belangrijke schakel is in de energietransitie. Lees hier zijn verhaal.


Lees het verhaal van Albert
**Sollicitatieproces**
----------------------

* 1### **Sollicitatie ontvangen**


Je ontvangt binnen 5 werkdagen een reactie van ons, tenzij in de vacaturetekst expliciet een andere reactietermijn is vermeld.
* 2### **Kennismakingsgesprek**


Tijd om elkaar te leren kennen. Wie ben je? Wat doe je graag? Waarom deze functie? En niet onbelangrijk: Wat wil jij weten van ons?
* 3### **Vervolggesprek**

* 4### **Arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek**

new_jobs.title: Professional Backend Developer Würzburg
new_jobs.description:
**Wer Du bist**



Du hast 3\-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Java\-Stack und beherrschst Spring Boot souverän. Du entwickelst komplexe Features eigenständig von der Konzeption bis zum Release, denkst analytisch und trägst aktiv zu Architekturentscheidungen bei. **Du nutzt KI\-Assistenz (z.B. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) als etabliertes Produktivitätswerkzeug** – nicht nur zum Code\-Generieren, sondern auch für komplexe Refactorings, Architektur\-Diskussionen und Debugging – übernimmst aber die volle Verantwortung für Qualität, Security und Nachvollziehbarkeit der Lösungen. Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert, kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe mit Stakeholdern und unterstützt gern weniger erfahrene Entwickler beim Wachsen.


**Wer wir sind**



Plunet GmbH mit Standorten in Berlin, Würzburg und New York entwickelt und vertreibt die Business\- und Workflow\-Management\-Software „Plunet BusinessManager“ – eine der weltweit führenden Managementlösungen für die Übersetzungs\- und Lokalisierungsbranche. Unsere Kunden sind führende Übersetzungsagenturen, Regierungsorganisationen und NGOs sowie große internationale Industrie\- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen.


**Aufgaben**
------------


* **Entwicklung \& Architektur:** Du entwirfst und implementierst komplexe, skalierbare Backend\-Lösungen mit Spring Boot, inkl. Konfiguration von Security\-Mechanismen und Integration von Drittbibliotheken. Du hilfst mit, technische Lösungen in unserer Software\-Architektur zu gestalten.
* **Qualitätssicherung:** Du führst Code Reviews durch und stellst umfassende Testabdeckung mit JUnit, Mockito und SpringBootTest sicher – inkl. komplexer Integrationstests
* **Legacy \& Modernisierung:** Du refactorst bestehenden Code und modernisierst Kernkomponenten (Main Classes), ohne dabei die Systemstabilität zu gefährden.
* **Datenbanken:** Du optimierst Datenbankabfragen und \-designs (MySQL/MSSQL) und setzt Hibernate als ORM\-Werkzeug für komplexe Mapping\-Szenarien fortgeschritten ein.
* **Wissenstransfer:** Du bist aktives Mitglied in unseren Communities of Practice (CoPs), leitest diese bei Bedarf und mentorst Junior\-Entwickler bei Onboarding und fachlicher Entwicklung.
* **Integration:** Du integrierst den Plunet BusinessManager mit externen Systemen und arbeitest eng mit Product Specialists zusammen.
* **KI\-Integration:** Du nutzt KI\-Tools effektiv für Entwicklungstasks, validierst generierten Code kritisch hinsichtlich Clean Code, Security und Performance und hilfst mit, Best Practices für den KI\-Einsatz im Team zu etablieren.
**Qualifikation**
-----------------

* **Erfahrung:** 3\-5 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung mit Schwerpunkt Backend/Java.
* **Java Advanced:** Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse von Design Patterns, Multithreading, Concurrency und aktuellen Java\-Versionen.
* **Spring Boot:** Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer, skalierbarer Anwendungen; sicherer Umgang mit Security\-Konfiguration und externer API\-Integration.
* **Softwaretests:** Advanced\-Level in Unit\- und Integrationstests mit JUnit, Mockito und SpringBootTest; Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung.
* **Datenbanken:** Fortgeschrittene SQL\-Kenntnisse (MySQL, MSSQL), Query\-Optimierung und sicherer Umgang mit Hibernate.
* **Tooling:** Sicherer Umgang mit Git, CI/CD\-Pipelines und modernen IDEs (IntelliJ, VSCode).
* **KI\-Assistenz Professional:** Erfahrener Umgang mit KI\-Coding\-Assistenz für komplexe Entwicklungsszenarien; Fähigkeit zum effektiven Prompt Engineering; kritische Bewertung von KI\-Vorschlägen hinsichtlich Architektur\-Patterns, Security\-Risiken und Datenschutz; Bewusstsein für Limitationen und Halluzinationen.
* **Clean Code:** Du lebst Clean Code\-Prinzipien aktiv und hilfst anderen dabei, besser zu werden.
* **Soft Skills:** Starke analytische Fähigkeit zur Analyse komplexer Anforderungen und Entwurf effizienter Lösungen; hervorragende Selbstorganisation (Priorisierung, Zeitmanagement); exzellente Kommunikations\- und Teamfähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit Architekten und Stakeholdern; Bereitschaft, Junior\-Entwickler zu mentoren und Wissen weiterzugeben.
* **Sprachen:** Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (B2\+), Deutsch ist ein Plus.


**Nice\-to\-haves (Zusätzliche Aktivitäten \& Skills)**


* **Security:** Erfahrung mit der Analyse und Behebung von Sicherheitslücken in Dependencies (OWASP Dependency\-Check, Sicherheitsmanagement).
* **DevOps/Tooling:** Kenntnisse in Liquibase, SonarQube, GitLab Administration oder Docker.
* **Performance:** Erfahrung mit Performance\-Analyse (Thread\-Dumps, Heap\-Dumps) und Last\-tests.
* **Fullstack\-Perspektive:** Grundkenntnisse in Angular, TypeScript oder .NET.
* **Methodik:** Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) als aktiver Teamplayer.
* **Schulung:** Du erstellst Präsentationen und Schulungen für andere Entwickler, um spezifisches Wissen zu verbreiten.

**Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!**
----------------------------------------------

**Diversity \& Inclusion**  

Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit, Fairness und gegenseitigen Respekt ein und ermutigen Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, sich zu bewerben.


**Anonymer Bewerbungsprozess**  

Du kannst dich gerne ohne Foto und ohne persönliche Angaben bewerben. Geschlecht, Alter, Name, Familienstand oder Herkunft sind für uns nicht entscheidend.



Überzeuge uns mit deinen Qualifikationen, deinen Fähigkeiten und deiner Motivation, Teil von Plunet zu werden.


**Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!**


  
Wir freuen uns über unser starkes Team! Tatsächlich sind aktuell alle Positionen bei Plunet besetzt. Wir haben daher momentan keine freien Stellen zu besetzen. Schau aber gerne zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt wieder vorbei und folge uns auf LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/plunet. Wir freuen uns über dein Interesse an Plunet.

  


#### **Diversität und Inklusion**



Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit, Fairness und gegenseitigen Respekt ein und ermutigen Menschen mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

  


#### **Anonymer Bewerbungsprozess**



Bewirb Dich bei uns ohne Foto und ohne persönliche Daten. Angaben zu Deinem Geschlecht, Alter, Namen, Familienstand, zu Deiner Herkunft und andere personenbezogene Informationen sind für die Bewerbung nicht wichtig. Überzeuge uns mit Deiner Qualifikation, Deinen Fähigkeiten und Deiner Motivation.

  


#### **Die weiteren Schritte nach Deiner Bewerbung**


* Du erhältst eine Bestätigung, dass Deine Unterlagen wohlbehalten bei uns angekommen sind
* Paulina setzt sich zeitnah per E\-Mail mit Dir in Verbindung, um weitere Eckpunkte zu klären und ein mögliches (Online\-)Interview zu vereinbaren
* Weil Du uns fachlich und menschlich überzeugst, wollen wir Dich nun auch vor Ort kennenlernen
* Ein Feedback hierzu erhältst Du bereits kurz darauf

  



Bei Fragen bezüglich unserer Stellen oder für weitere Informationen über uns kannst Du Dich gern direkt an unsere People \& Culture Managerin Paulina mit einer Nachricht an jobs@plunet.com wenden.



Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen!

new_jobs.title: Software Entwickler (all genders)
new_jobs.description:
#### **Einleitungstext**


Übernimm die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung der zentralen Softwareanwendung unserer neuen Mikroskopplattform. In dieser Schlüsselrolle gestaltest du sowohl die technische Softwarebasis als auch eine innovative und nutzerorientierte Benutzeroberfläche, die den vielfältigen Anforderungen unserer Kunden und Märkte gerecht wird.  

Mit deinem Know\-how in der Softwareentwicklung und im UI/UX\-Design verwandelst du komplexe Anforderungen in intuitive, leistungsstarke Lösungen. Du bringst technische Exzellenz und Nutzerbedürfnisse in Einklang und leistest damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Erfolg und zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte.

#### **Was Dich erwartet**

* Du definierst, konzipierst und implementierst die Software sowie die Gesamtarchitektur unserer neuen Mikroskopplattform und baust dabei, wo sinnvoll, auf bestehenden Lösungen auf
* Du entwickelst und implementierst eine innovative, nutzerzentrierte grafische Benutzeroberfläche (GUI)
* Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen von Kunden, Anwendern und Märkten in intuitive und leistungsstarke Softwarelösungen
* Du stellst eine hohe Systemperformance sowie Stabilität und Skalierbarkeit der Software sicher
* Du arbeitest eng mit Teams aus den Bereichen Hardware, Systementwicklung, Softwareentwicklung und Physik zusammen, um bestehende und neue Softwarekomponenten nahtlos zu integrieren
* Du förderst den Wissensaustausch im Team, treibst kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voran und sorgst für eine nachhaltige technische Dokumentation

#### **Was Du mitbringst**

* Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Softwaretechnik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets
* Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwareanwendungen mit, idealerweise im Umfeld von Bildgebungssystemen mit hoher Anwenderinteraktion
* Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwareentwicklungspraktiken, insbesondere in den Bereichen Softwarearchitektur, Schnittstellenentwicklung, Performance\-Optimierung, Wartbarkeit, Testing sowie CI/CD
* Du bringst umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Benutzeroberflächen (GUI), Usability\-Konzepten und nutzerzentriertem Design mit
* Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit C\#/.NET, C\+\+ und Python mit
* Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von grafischen Benutzeroberflächen für Windows (.NET/WPF) ist für diese Rolle erforderlich. Kenntnisse alternativer Technologien wie Blazor vorteilhaft
* Idealerweise verfügst du zudem über Erfahrung in der Entwicklung plattformübergreifender Anwendungen für Windows und Linux
* Kenntnisse in der Bildaufnahme und Bildverarbeitung mit C\+\+ und Python sowie im Umgang mit Bibliotheken wie OpenCV oder Intel IPP sind wünschenswert
* Erfahrungen in den Bereichen CUDA\-Entwicklung, Hardwareansteuerung, Framegrabber oder FPGAs sind ein Plus
* Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations\- und Teamfähigkeiten und arbeitest gerne bereichsübergreifend mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen
* Du zeichnest dich durch eine strukturierte, qualitätsbewusste und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

#### **Was wir Dir bieten**

* Eine aufregende Tätigkeit bei einem international tätigen, etablierten mittelständischen Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Flexibilität für ziel\- und ergebnisorientiertes Arbeiten in einem kollegialen, offenen und respektvollen Arbeitsumfeld
* Wir unterstützen Freiheit \& Flexibilität in Bezug auf Arbeitszeiten und Home Office sowie 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr
* Eine gute Einarbeitung ist für uns sehr wichtig. Ein individuelles Onboarding sowie ein attoBuddy stehen Dir zur Seite
* Life long learning wird bei uns mit gezielten Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten unterstützt
* Hochmodernes Bürogebäude mit guter Anbindung ans Münchner S\-Bahn\-Netz, Mitarbeiterparkplätze, JobRad und Fahrradstellplätze sowie Duschmöglichkeiten
* Durch Coporate Benefits gibt es jede Menge Rabatte für Mitarbeitende
* Auch der Spaß sollte nicht zu kurz kommen, deshalb veranstalten wir mehrere Company \& Teamevents
* Deine Gesundheit unterstützen wir durch unsere attoCare, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitstage und der Möglichkeit einer EGYM\-Mitgliedschaft
* Frisches Obst und Getränke sind kostenfrei und die täglich frischen Gerichte in unserem Betriebsrestaurant sind subventioniert

#### **Schlusssatz**

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt in Deiner Karriere? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Präzisionstechnologie. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

#### **Kontaktperson**


Sarah Bortoli

#### **Über uns**


Die attocube systems GmbH steht international für Innovation und Exzellenz in der Entwicklung, der Produktion und dem Vertrieb anspruchsvollster Lösungen für Nanotechnologie\-Anwendungen in Industrie und Forschung. Das Portfolio umfasst ultrapräzise Nano\-Antriebe, Sensoren, Kryostaten und ganzheitliche Mikroskopsysteme, die nah an der Grenze des physikalisch\-technisch Machbaren arbeiten.

new_jobs.title: Backend-Entwickler .NET / C# (w/m/d) bei der SP Consult AG
new_jobs.description:
#### **Werde Teil unseres Teams**

**Als Backend\-Entwickler .NET / C\# (w/m/d) bei der SP Consult AG bist Du das Fundament unserer Software: Du entwickelst robuste, skalierbare und sichere Server\-Anwendungen, Schnittstellen und Datenbanklösungen, die auch bei großen Events zuverlässig laufen. Bei uns erwarten Dich spannende technische Herausforderungen, ein starker Teamzusammenhalt und echte Verantwortung für das, was Du baust.**

#### **Das sind Deine Aufgaben**

Du analysierst komplexe Probleme strukturiert und entwickelst pragmatische, nachhaltige Lösungen.

new_jobs.description:
Garmin is a leading active tech company. The company develops innovative products for people who live an active life – from smartwatches and bike computers to airplane cockpits and marine radars. Founded in 1989 in Olathe, Kansas, by Gary Burrell and Min Kao, Garmin is today known for a broad, highly differentiated product portfolio in five different segments: outdoor, fitness, aviation, automotive and marine. Over 19,000 employees in 35 countries across the globe help Garmin customers discover their passions and live more active, conscious and healthy lives in line with the Garmin claim “Beat Yesterday”.  

  

In the DACH region, Garmin has offices in Garching near Munich (Germany), Graz (Austria) and Neuhausen (Switzerland). Approximately 250 employees work at these locations. The company also operates a research and development facility in Würzburg (Germany).  

A key principle behind Garmin’s success and its extraordinary product quality is the company’s vertical integration: with only a few exceptions, Garmin develops and produces its products and their entire technological ecosystem in\-house. From innovative sensors to the Garmin Connect app, from concept, design and production to sales and customer support.  

  

We are successful together and you can become a part of it \- true to our motto "Together in Würzburg with our colleagues worldwide".

  

### **OUR AOEM CYBER SECURITY TEAM IS LOOKING FOR A**

**Staff Security Architect (m/f/d)**
------------------------------------

### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Lead product security strategy and architecture across the full product lifecycle
* Provide technical leadership for secure product design, development, and deployment
* Drive threat modeling, risk assessments, and security reviews
* Define and implement security standards, policies, and best practices
* Partner with engineering, customers, suppliers, and regulatory stakeholders on security initiatives
* Champion security tools, automation, and scalable engineering solutions
* Provide strategic security guidance for product and business decisions
* Represent the company as a trusted security expert in external engagements
* Build security awareness and capability through training and mentoring
### **EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND SKILLS REQUIRED:**

* Bachelor's degree plus 14 years of relevant engineering experience
* Relevant product security or information security experience, including working knowledge of cryptography, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), software and application security (AppSec), secure software development practices, and hardware\-based security controls
* Demonstrates expertise in product security architecture, threat modeling and risk assessment, security requirements and acceptance criteria, secure design review, vulnerability management, security verification planning, and pragmatic risk mitigation
* Demonstrates ability to lead major technical efforts, influence cross\-functional engineering decisions, author standards and guidance, and communicate security risk and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders
* Demonstrates strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Demonstrates ability to work collaboratively and professionally with others under challenging circumstances
* Must possess detailed knowledge and experience with high\-level language structure in C, C\+\+, C\#, Rust, Python, and/or Java relevant to Garmin business needs

* Must possess pragmatic business analysis skills and apply them to threat prioritization, architecture trade\-offs, and security investment decisions

Flexible working hours \& 30 days' vacation  

Fair pay and special benefits such as VL, bAV, job ticket or cash card and much more.  

Free use of our products in your free time, Family \& Friends discount for Garmin products and participation in the Garmin share program

new_jobs.title: Security Architect
new_jobs.description:
At the heart of everything we do is our vision to change lives every day, and our mission to grow The National Lottery responsibly and champion its impact.

  



We are Allwyn UK, part of the Allwyn Entertainment Group – a multi\-national lottery operator with a market\-leading presence across the USA (Michigan and Illinois) and Europe, including Czech Republic, Austria, Greece, Cyprus and Italy.

  

While the main contribution of The National Lottery to society is through the funds to good causes, at Allwyn we put our purpose and values at the heart of everything we do. Join us as we embark on a once\-in\-a\-lifetime, largescale transformation journey by creating a National Lottery that delivers more money to good causes.

  

We’ll talk a bit more about us further down the page, but for now – let’s talk about the role and who we’re looking for…

  

About the role


Working within the Enterprise Security team, you will provide specialist security architecture for customer\-facing and enterprise applications across web, mobile, API and supporting cloud services. You will shape secure designs from discovery through delivery, translate risk into proportionate security requirements, and help engineering teams embed security throughout the software development lifecycle.

  

This is an architecture\-led role with practical application security depth. You will not simply identify vulnerabilities: you will influence application and platform design, define reusable patterns, guide security testing, support remediation decisions and provide clear risk advice to technical and business stakeholders.

  

What you’ll be doing

* Provide security architecture support to mobile and web application initiatives from discovery and design through build, testing, release and operation.
* Partner with solution architects, software engineers, product teams, delivery leads and third parties to ensure security is designed in early without losing sight of pace, cost, usability and quality.
* Produce and maintain high\-level and detailed security designs, security requirements, architecture decisions, patterns and supporting assurance evidence.
* Lead application threat modelling using structured techniques such as STRIDE, documenting threats, attack paths, trust boundaries, mitigations and residual risks.
* Assess web applications, native and cross\-platform mobile applications, APIs, microservices, identity flows, cloud services and third\-party integrations.
* Define security requirements for authentication, authorisation, session management, secrets, cryptography, data protection, API security, logging, monitoring, resilience and secure configuration.
* Apply recognised application security guidance, including OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, OWASP MASVS and relevant secure\-by\-design principles.
* Guide teams on secure mobile design, including secure storage, platform permissions, transport security, certificate handling, local data protection, application integrity and mobile backend/API controls.
* Guide teams on secure web design, including browser security controls, input and output handling, access control, session security, dependency risk and protection against common web attack classes.
* Advise on application security testing strategy, including SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, API testing, mobile application testing, IAST and penetration testing.
* Support the integration of proportionate security controls and automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, including the definition of quality gates and exception routes.
* Review security findings, challenge false positives where appropriate, prioritise remediation based on risk and support teams in agreeing pragmatic corrective actions.
* Produce penetration test scopes and security test plans, coordinate internal and external testing, and assess whether findings have been adequately remediated.
* Identify and communicate security risks, control gaps and non\-compliance clearly, supporting accountable owners to reach an informed risk position.
* Contribute to reusable security patterns, standards, guardrails and reference architectures for mobile, web and API delivery.
* Coach engineering and architecture communities on secure design, threat modelling and secure development practices.

  

What experience we’re looking for


Must Have:

* Significant experience in application security architecture, product security or security engineering within an enterprise environment.
* Security design experience across modern web applications, mobile applications and APIs.
* Strong knowledge of common web, mobile and API threats and appropriate security controls.
* Practical experience of threat modelling and translating findings into clear, traceable security requirements.
* Good understanding of secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Agile delivery and CI/CD security.
* Experience defining and interpreting application security testing, including SAST, DAST, SCA, API, mobile and penetration testing.
* Knowledge of application identity and access management, including authentication, authorisation, federation, tokens and session security.
* Understanding of cloud\-native architecture, including containers, serverless services and microservices.
* Experience assessing data flows and defining controls for sensitive data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, pragmatic and risk\-based advice


Technical knowledge

* Web and API security, including HTTP/S, browser controls, CORS, CSP, REST and GraphQL.
* iOS and Android security, including secure storage, permissions, deep links, transport security and application integrity.
* Application security tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of a mainstream programming or scripting language.
* Security logging, monitoring and incident response for customer\-facing applications.
* Relevant frameworks and standards, including OWASP, NIST, ISO 27001, CIS and PCI DSS.


Nice to Have:

* Experience securing high\-volume digital services in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of app\-store releases, mobile attestation, application shielding or runtime protection.
* Familiarity with container security, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or policy as code.
* Experience developing application security patterns, standards or developer enablement programmes.
* A relevant security certification such as CISSP, CSSLP, SABSA, CREST or OSWE.
* Experience in lottery, gaming, payments, retail, finance or another regulated sector.


About us


At Allwyn, we are dedicated to changing lives and growing the National Lottery responsibly, championing its positive impact on people, places, and the planet.

  

* Innovation \- We pride ourselves on it! We’re constantly looking for new ways to excite our customers, bringing new products to market to enjoy which is all supported by our responsible play values and making them accessible to all.
* Giving back – Did you know that playing the lottery generates around £30m a week for charities and good causes in the UK? Our aim is to have doubled this number by the end of the first 10\-year license.
* Sustainability – Our aim is to become a net zero national lottery. We have 2030 targets to decarbonise our operations and energy. We’ve already transitioned to renewable energy providers, made our London and Watford offices zero gas, and ensured our fleet consists of low\-emission vehicles. In addition, we’re working with our value chain partners to develop a net zero target date.
* Empowering every voice – We believe in creating a culture where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, has access to opportunities and can thrive for the benefit of good causes. Our diverse teams are working hard to make all parts of The National Lottery inclusive – whether people play a game in a store or online, because when everyone can play, everyone wins..

  

An inclusive reward offering with wellbeing at the centre


At Allwyn, inclusion is built into how we care for our people. Our benefits and policies support colleagues and their families at every stage of life and career. By prioritising wellbeing and belonging, we create a workplace where everyone feels valued, rewarded, and empowered to succeed. Our people are more than colleagues \- they’re winners, driving positive change and making a real difference in communities.

  

Benefits

* Company Bonus Scheme
* Matched pension contributions up to 8\.5%
* 26 days annual leave \+ 2 Life Days (and bank holidays)
* Single Private Health Cover
* Complimentary Private Medical
* Income Protection
* Flexible Benefits – EV Scheme, Money Coach, Will Writing, Mortgage Advice, Dental and Eye Care Schemes.
* Enhanced Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity, Adoption)
* Wellness Allowance £500
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Discounted Health Assessments
* Volunteering Days
* Matched Funding

  

We are a Disability Confident Leader which means we’ve taken proactive steps to ensure our workplace is accessible and inclusive for disabled and neurodivergent colleagues and candidates. As part of this we offer an interview to disabled applicants who meet the essential requirements of the job.

  

If you need any assistance or adjustments to this job description or in the application process, please contact a member of the talent team at careers@allwyn.co.uk and we’ll be happy to help.

You will join a team which:  

* Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review

* Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
* Drives end\-to\-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
* Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
* Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

  

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona  

  

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net\-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders

Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short\-, mid\-, and long\-term technical decisions with large\-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability \& Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.  

  

About the team  

The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. new_jobs.description:
### **Job Description**


At AFRY, we believe that sound has the power to shape how people experience the places where they live, work and meet.


We are now looking for an Acoustician with a strong background in building acoustics and environmental noise to join our growing Acoustics, Sound and Vibration team in Sweden, with around 80 acousticians across the country.


This is an opportunity for an ambitious acoustic engineer who wants to work on challenging projects, collaborate with leading specialists across disciplines and contribute to projects both in Sweden and internationally.


As an Acoustician at AFRY, you will work with a broad range of projects within building acoustics and environmental noise. You will be involved from early\-stage studies and concept development through detailed design and construction.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Building acoustics and acoustic design of residential, office, educational, healthcare and public buildings
* Environmental noise assessments related to road and rail traffic, industry and urban development
* Acoustic calculations, modelling and simulations
* Noise mapping and prediction
* Evaluation of acoustic measurements
* Development of acoustic solutions, strategies and mitigation measures
* Preparation of technical specifications
* Providing expert advice to project teams

You will have the opportunity to work across the full project lifecycle and develop your expertise in the areas where you can create the greatest value.


### **Qualifications**


**Must have:**


* A university degree in acoustics, engineering, physics, building physics or a related field
* 5\+ years of professional experience as an acoustician or acoustic consultant
* Solid experience in building acoustics and/or environmental noise
* Experience of acoustic calculations, modelling and technical analysis
* Experience working in multidisciplinary construction or infrastructure projects
* The ability to communicate complex acoustic issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* A structured and independent way of working
* Strong written and spoken English

Experience in building acoustics within **healthcare projects** is particularly valuable.


Experience with software such as SoundPLAN, CadnaA, CadnaB, SONArchitect, INSUL, Bastian, Odeon, Treble, Rhino/Grasshopper, Sketchup, AutoCAD, Revit, BIM is an advantage. Experience with equivalent tools is also highly relevant.


Knowledge of Swedish acoustic standards and regulations is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.


Knowledge and experience within the following areas are particularly valuable:


* Façade and window sound insulation calculations with respect to road and rail traffic noise
* Airborne sound insulation calculations between rooms
* Impact sound insulation calculations between rooms
* Preparation of drawings and documentation specifying acoustic requirements for walls, glazed partitions and doors
* Sound transmission calculations between rooms, including break\-in and break\-out noise through ventilation ducts
* Noise assessment of air handling units and ventilation fan systems
* Room acoustic simulations and calculations, including reverberation time and Speech Transmission Index (STI).

### **Company Description**


AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.


AFRY employs over 18,000 professionals in more than 50 countries. Net sales in 2024 were SEK 27,160 million.


AFRY is organized into three Divisions: Energy; Industry and Transportation \& Places.


The Global Division Transportation \& Places is active within transportation infrastructure, real estate, water and environment in the Nordics and Central Europe. The division has about 6,500 employees and is structured around two segments: Road \& Rail and Public \& Commercial Places.

To individuals who join our team, we offer:


* Employment based on an employment contract
* Private medical insurance, life assurance, sport card (Multisport) and a social found
* 50% tax\-deductible costs for income from creative activities managed by the employer
* Exciting and challenging projects
* Personal development opportunities
* Friendly working atmosphere in a multidisciplinary and international team
* Helping to shape a sustainable future

Available office locations for this position are either in Poznań, Kraków or Łódź. We are ﬂexible on the office location for this position, please indicate your preference in your covering letter. We value a healthy work life balance and are committed to your wellbeing. We will operate a hybrid working environment.


*We are excited to receive your application,* ***please ensure your CV is in English****.*


Should you be successful you will be invited for a telephone interview followed by a 2 steps virtual or live face to face interview.


*At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. Fast stilling Heltid Oslo
* Søknadsfrist **Snarest**
* Arbeidsspråk **Norsk**
* Sektor **Privat**

  
**Senior dataingeniør, eiendoms\- og geodata**
==============================================


Vi søker en erfaren dataingeniør som vil bygge og drifte dataplattformen bak Placepoint. Du henter inn, modellerer og leverer eiendoms\-, selskaps\- og kartdata fra Norge og Sverige, sammen med oss to som gjør det i dag, og du bruker AI som et fast verktøy i jobben.


Om oss
Placepoint samler eiendomsinformasjon, eierskap, regulering, transaksjoner og kartdata i én plattform for Norge og Sverige. Over 850 kunder bruker oss, blant dem eiendomsbesittere, utviklere, banker, forsikringsselskaper, meglere og advokater. Vi er over 70 ansatte og holder til i Oslo sentrum.
  

Dataene er kjernen i det vi leverer. Vi henter dem fra offentlige registre som Matrikkelen, Grunnboken og Enhetsregisteret, fra svenske kilder som Lantmäteriet og Bolagsverket, og fra over 2 300 kartlag. Kundene bruker dem i Placepoint Fusion, Placepoint API og gjennom våre MCP\-servere som lar AI\-assistenter slå opp i dataene direkte.  

  



Slik jobber vi
AI er en del av hvordan vi utvikler. Hvert repo har instruksjoner for Claude Code og Cursor, mye av koden skrives sammen med en AI\-agent, og vi bygger egne MCP\-servere så kunder og kolleger kan bruke dataene våre fra Claude og andre assistenter. Vi forventer at du bruker AI mye, og at du er med på å finne ut hvordan vi kan bruke det bedre.
  

Vi er et lite datateam med bredt ansvar. Den som bygger et dataløp, drifter det også, og vi rydder opp i årsaken når noe feiler.  

  



Dette skal du jobbe med
* Utvikle og optimalisere databasene våre i SQL Server og PostGIS: lagrede prosedyrer, datamodeller, indekser, partisjonering og ytelse på store tabeller.
* Bygge og drifte dataløp som henter registerdata hver natt og hver uke, med Azure Data Factory, Python\-jobber i Azure og dbt.
* Følge med på at kjøringene går, finne feilen når de ikke gjør det, og gjøre dem robuste nok til at det skjer sjeldnere.
* Modellere og koble norske og svenske registre: eiendom, bygg, adresser, selskaper, roller, eierskap og transaksjoner.
* Videreutvikle Placepoint API, MCP\-serverne våre og søkeindeksene i Azure AI Search.
* Ta inn nye kartlag og datakilder, og holde dem oppdatert.
* Levere datasett til kunder og hjelpe kolleger i produkt og salg med data og analyser.

Vi ser etter deg som
* har minst seks års relevant arbeidserfaring
* har høyere utdanning innen informatikk, geomatikk, matematikk eller lignende, eller tilsvarende arbeidserfaring
* er svært god på SQL Server eller PostgreSQL: du skriver effektiv SQL, leser spørringsplaner, lager indekser som holder og modellerer data som skal leve lenge
* har bygget og driftet dataløp i produksjon, med Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt eller tilsvarende
* programmerer godt i Python eller C\#, gjerne begge
* bruker Claude, Cursor eller lignende AI\-verktøy mye i hverdagen, eller er motivert for å gjøre det
* snakker og skriver norsk flytende

Det er et pluss om du har erfaring med
* PostGIS og geodata: geometri, koordinatsystemer som EUREF89 UTM, GeoJSON, GeoParquet og vektorfliser
* norske registre og kartdata: Enhetsregisteret, Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Aksjonærregisteret og FKB fra Kartverket
* svenske registre og data: Lantmäteriet, Bolagsverket og SCB
* API\-design, MCP\-servere og søkemotorer som Azure AI Search eller Elasticsearch
* Azure: Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault og Data Lake
* Go
* 3D\-data og bygningsmodeller
* eiendomsbransjen eller finans

Ingen har alt dette. Vi jobber bredt, og du lærer nye verktøy mens du bruker dem. Det som veier tyngst, er at du lærer fort, bruker AI godt og bryr deg om at dataene er riktige.  

  



Om deg
* Du legger merke til når tall ikke stemmer, og graver til du finner årsaken.
* Du tar ansvar for det du lager, også etter at det er i drift.
* Du jobber selvstendig, deler det du finner og ber om hjelp når det sparer tid.
* Du kan forklare et datasett og begrensningene i det til en kollega som ikke er utvikler.
* Du trives med å jobbe på kontoret sammen med teamet.
**Ferdigheter**
---------------

* Data Engineering
* Data Modeling
* Kodegjennomgang
* kvalitetssikring av data
* Orkestrere musikk
* PostGIS
* Python (dataprogrammering)
* SQL

  
**Om arbeidsgiveren**
---------------------


Placepoint bygger dataplattformen for eiendom i Norge og Sverige.


Banker, eiendomsutviklere, investorer og rådgivere bruker plattformen til å finne, analysere og følge eiendommer, selskaper og planer, med data fra Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Brønnøysundregistrene, Lantmäteriet og en rekke andre kilder samlet på ett sted.


* Sted: Tordenskiolds Gate 2, 0177 Oslo
* Bransje: Eiendom, IT \- programvare
* Stillingsfunksjon: Dataingeniør
**Nøkkelord**
-------------


lakehouse, dbt, postgis, mcp, ETL



**Spørsmål om stillingen**
--------------------------


FF
Frede Fardal


CPO


JB
Jarle Bjørnbeth

You will evolve a vendor\-built BI solution into a **modern, product\-grade data platform** and ensure that data is transformed into **scalable, trusted, and actionable insights** for both our customers and internal teams. You’re not just building dashboards, you’re enabling better decisions and measurable impact.

We're looking for a **Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us design, build, operate, and scale robust backend systems and platforms.



You'll work hands\-on with backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, and production systems, helping us build reliable and scalable solutions that can support large user bases and growing workloads.



You'll work closely with Engineering, Product, BI, and other teams, contributing to architecture and technical decision\-making while supporting systems throughout their lifecycle, from development through production and live operations.



You'll also work with modern AI services and APIs, integrating AI models and AI\-powered capabilities into our backend systems and products.

* Contribute to system architecture and long\-term technical decisions
* Build service layers and reusable components that can support multiple products and use cases

* Identify technical bottlenecks and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, error handling, and system health tracking

**AI \& Integrations**

* Evaluate opportunities to use AI to improve product capabilities, workflows, and automation

### **Success Looks Like**

* Maintaining strong system reliability, performance, and uptime in live production environments

new_jobs.title: FDE - Data Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Your role**
-------------

At Kyndryl, **Forward Deployed Engineers work where data, cloud, and AI become real** . This is not a traditional consulting role or a back\-office engineering position. Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customers to design, build, and deploy modern data solutions that operate in complex, regulated, production environments.


As a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) – Data Engineering \& GCP** , you will own defined delivery workstreams within customer engagements, designing and building scalable data platforms, pipelines, and data products primarily on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** .


You will operate with growing independence in customer environments, combining strong hands\-on Data Engineering expertise with business context. You will translate ambiguous business and data challenges into robust, production\-ready solutions, from rapid prototypes and MVPs through industrialization and production deployment.


The role sits at the intersection of **Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, AI enablement, consulting, and delivery accountability** . You will work across the data lifecycle—from ingestion and transformation to orchestration, governance, observability, and data serving—creating trusted data foundations for analytics, operational workloads, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.


You will use modern engineering and AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate solution design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment, while building the customer trust required to drive adoption and long\-term impact.


**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Customer Engagement \& Solution Engineering:** Partner directly with customers to understand business and data challenges and translate them into high\-quality, fit\-for\-purpose technical solutions, balancing delivery speed with scalability, maintainability, security, and long\-term architectural integrity.
* **Data Engineering on GCP:** Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and data platforms using technologies such as **BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer/Airflow, and Dataform** , selecting the right services and patterns for each workload.
* **Data Architecture \& Modernization:** Contribute to the design and implementation of modern cloud data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouse patterns, batch and streaming processing, and migrations from legacy or on\-premises data platforms to GCP.
* **Rapid Prototyping:** Build and iterate PoCs, MVPs, and production\-oriented prototypes to validate architecture decisions, integration patterns, performance, and business value quickly with real customer data and environments.
* **Ownership, Deployment \& Partnership:** Own delivery workstreams end to end—from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production stabilization. Work as part of the customer team rather than operating only as an external advisor.
* **Data Integration \& Processing:** Implement robust batch and real\-time ingestion, transformation, and processing patterns across heterogeneous data sources, APIs, databases, files, event streams, and enterprise platforms.
* **Production Engineering:** Build solutions with production requirements in mind, including **CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, monitoring, observability, security, IAM, data quality, lineage, and operational supportability** .
* **Performance \& Cost Optimization:** Troubleshoot and optimize data workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost, particularly across BigQuery, Spark/Dataproc, Dataflow, and other GCP data services.
* **AI \& ML Data Enablement:** Build and integrate the data foundations required for Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions, including reliable data pipelines, feature preparation, data quality, vector and unstructured data processing, and integration with GCP AI services such as **Vertex AI** .
* **Field Intelligence:** Systematically capture deployment learnings, reusable patterns, technical accelerators, and best practices from customer engagements and share them across Kyndryl engineering and delivery teams.
* **Continuous Learning:** Stay current with the evolving GCP data ecosystem, modern Data Engineering practices, AI\-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies, applying new capabilities pragmatically to customer problems.
* **Platform \& Engineering Contribution:** Contribute reusable code, reference architectures, automation, frameworks, and feedback that improve Kyndryl’s Data \& AI engineering capabilities and accelerate future customer engagements.

  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python, (or another modern language such as C\#, Node.js or TypeScript); experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus •Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git \& GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark •Cloud \& Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures Preferred skills and experience •Open\-Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community\-driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories •T\-shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting •Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi\-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms •Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) \& Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions •Performance \& Security: Knowledge of system\-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems •Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences •Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required •Education: Degree\-level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline \- or equivalent professional experience  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

new_jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud-Native, AI-Driven Platform)
new_jobs.description:
**Descripción de la empresa**  

Septeo es un actor europeo líder en el sector del software con presencia internacional, reconocido como uno de los cinco principales proveedores de software vertical en Francia. En plena fase de rápido crecimiento y transformación constante, el grupo se ha consolidado como un referente en la industria del software, impulsado por la fortaleza de unos equipos decididos, audaces y comprometidos.


En Septeo, la inteligencia artificial es el eje de nuestra evolución. La entendemos como un motor de rendimiento sostenible, colaboración e innovación, integrada de manera responsable en las prácticas cotidianas y democratizada en todas nuestras áreas de negocio. Nuestra ambición es clara: «crear software inteligente para Europa».


Nuestra cultura se cimenta en valores sólidos: ser, hacer y transformar juntos. No es una cultura estática; se vive día a día en nuestras acciones y decisiones, logrando un equilibrio entre rendimiento, responsabilidad y disfrute.


Esta ambición se refleja en nuestra labor diaria: diseñar software que acompaña los momentos esenciales de la vida, al servicio de millones de ciudadanos. Desempeñar un papel en estos momentos clave conlleva una gran responsabilidad. Es una responsabilidad que asumimos con orgullo y que pronto podría ser también la tuya.


Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.

 **Descripción del empleo**  

We are building the next generation of AI\-native software for the hospitality industry. Our platform powers complex, multi\-tenant environments across multiple companies and product lines, operating in high\-availability, high\-performance scenarios.


Our systems handle critical operational workflows where uptime, scalability, and security are non\-negotiable. As we evolve toward AI\-native capabilities and intelligent automation, our infrastructure must be resilient, observable, and ready to scale dynamically.


We believe DevOps is not a support function — it is a core engineering discipline that enables product velocity, reliability, and innovation.


If you enjoy designing robust infrastructure, automating everything, and building platforms that engineers love to use, we’d love to meet you.

**How You’ll Have Impact**

* **Build the Platform Behind the Platform**: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi\-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
* **Enable Engineering Velocity**: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
* **Drive Reliability \& Observability**: Ensure high availability, performance, and real\-time visibility across distributed systems.
* **Architect for Scale**: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
* **Champion Infrastructure as Code**: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
* **Embed Security by Design**: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in **AWS and/or Azure**.
* Manage and optimize containerized workloads using **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (**Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI** or equivalent).
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
* Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (**ELK stack**, **Grafana** dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
* Operate, monitor, and tune **Microsoft SQL Server** databases (performance, backups, high availability).
* Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers (**Java / Kotlin, C\#, Node.js**) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
* Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tooling (**Claude, Codex**, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.


You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

**Cloud Building Blocks: AWS \& Azure**


We run workloads on **both AWS and Azure**. We are looking for solid hands\-on experience with **IaaS** and core managed cloud services on at least one of them — knowing the equivalent on the other cloud is a strong plus. These are the building blocks you’ll work with:

* **Virtual machines \& autoscaling** — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets \| AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
* **Virtual networking** — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints \| AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
* **L7 load balancing \+ WAF** — Azure: Application Gateway \+ WAF \| AWS: Application Load Balancer \+ AWS WAF
* **Web app / API hosting** — Azure: App Service \| AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
* **Managed Kubernetes** — Azure: AKS \| AWS: EKS
* **Message queues** — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues \| AWS: Amazon SQS
* **Object storage** — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs \| AWS: Amazon S3
* **In\-memory cache** — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis \| AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
* **Managed SQL Server** — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance \| AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
* **Workload identity (secretless auth)** — Azure: Managed Identity \+ DefaultAzureCredential \| AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) \+ SDK default credential chain
* **Secrets \& keys** — Azure: Key Vault \| AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
* **Transactional email** — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) \| AWS: Amazon SES
* **Per\-environment configuration** — Azure: App Settings \| AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
* **Logs, metrics \& alerts** — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor \| AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
* **Runtime diagnostics** — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics \| AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

  

**Requisitos**  

* 5\+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **AWS or Azure** — experience with both is a strong plus.
* Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with **production experience in Kubernetes** (required).
* Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
* Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft SQL Server** (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
* Experience with **Redis** in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
* Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
* Experience working in high\-availability SaaS environments.
* Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including **Grafana** dashboards and alerting.
* Automation\-first mindset.
* Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
* **Languages**: fluent **Spanish** and professional **English** (both required).


We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands\-on experience with **at least one technology in each area**: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers \& orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases \& caching.

**Nice\-to\-Have Superpowers**

* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
* Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
* Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
* Experience in multi\-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with **both AWS and Azure**.
* Scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* **French** — a huge plus (we can dream!).

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* High ownership and architectural impact.
* Cloud\-native SaaS platform with real scale challenges.
* Opportunity to shape infrastructure evolution toward AI\-native capabilities.
* Cross\-functional, product\-driven engineering culture.
* International environment with technical autonomy.

  

**Información adicional**  

* Participar en la aventura AI First de Septeo y descubrir nuevas formas de trabajar gracias a la inteligencia artificial.
* Crecer y desarrollarse gracias a un itinerario de formación personalizado y a oportunidades de movilidad interna.
* Vivir una experiencia humana, intercambiar y compartir en eventos temáticos como encuentros afterwork, actividades deportivas, iniciativas de RSC, seminarios y mucho más.
* Unirse a un equipo que cuida de los demás y se compromete con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la inclusión.

* **Engineering Mentorship:** Mentor Senior and Principal Engineers on the Vantage team; build a culture of technical rigor, shared ownership, and continuous learning.

* Proven experience designing, implementing, and operating CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, and deploying workflows using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps Pipelines
* Strong command of microservices architecture, distributed system design, and cloud\-native patterns at enterprise scale
* Demonstrated ability to mentor Senior and Mid\-level Engineers and partner with Engineering Managers on technical direction
* Experience leading technical design reviews and influencing architectural decisions across team and product boundaries


**Desired Qualifications**


* Experience in cloud, preferably using Microsoft Azure (AKS, Storage, Key Vaults, Azure SQL or equivalent)
* Track record of delivering production\-grade systems that meet enterprise compliance, security, and reliability standards
* Hands\-on experience designing and operating workflow\-driven systems (orchestration, retries, timeouts, and state management)
* Experience integrating Machine Learning, Neural Networks or LLMs into enterprise applications and workflows
* Comfort operating across a globally distributed engineering organization spanning multiple regions and cultures

The anticipated base salary range for this position is between **25,000,000 HUF and 26,000,000 HUF annually**. **Love how you work**



* We provide remote and hybrid working options to fit all lifestyles.

Description
**Full\-Stack Software Engineer .NET \| C\# \| Azure**
======================================================

**About Us**
------------

  

We are a mobility provider based in Luxembourg, operating public transport, shuttles and on\-demand services across the region. Our Digital Factory builds products that help the people behind these services work more effectively.


You will join the Foundry, our small software development team. We bring different areas of expertise, enjoy solving problems together and make time to help each other. We value the way people listen, learn and collaborate as much as the technical knowledge they bring.

**About Our Digital Transformation**
------------------------------------

  

We are modernising the applications and systems that support our operations, with C\#, .NET and Azure at the heart of our software environment and Microsoft Fabric supporting our data foundation.


You will contribute to a varied portfolio of digital products addressing operational and business challenges across the organisation. For example, we are building applications that help teams understand and improve workshop workflows, from welcoming a vehicle and organising maintenance to following work through to completion. We are also developing tools to analyse kilometres travelled without passengers, combining vehicle telemetry, reconciliation of planned and actual journeys, calculation logic and clear user interfaces to help teams investigate differences and identify potential savings.


These are two examples among a broader and evolving portfolio. Our products can combine operational workflows, user\-facing applications, system integrations and live or frequently updated vehicle data. This can include location, energy consumption, vehicle condition and other telemetry generated by a connected fleet. The work offers opportunities to solve problems across several technical dimensions and different areas of the business.

**About Your Role**
-------------------

  

You will design, build and improve digital products across the full stack, from user interfaces to backend services, APIs and application databases. Your work will include developing features used directly by operational teams, connecting existing systems and improving the reliability and usability of our applications.


You will also contribute to the shared technical foundations behind these products. This may include reusable services, integration patterns and common components that make future applications easier to build, connect and maintain. The role combines visible product development with deeper engineering work that can benefit several solutions across the organisation.


Understanding the business problem is part of the job. Working with Product Owners, Business Analysts and operational colleagues, you will explore how people work, clarify requirements and help shape practical solutions. You will consider how a change affects the wider workflow, its users and the systems around it, looking for the simplest approach that addresses the underlying need.


You will take ownership of agreed work through development, testing, deployment and production follow\-up, with responsibilities suited to your experience. Our Tech Lead and colleagues will support you through code reviews, pairing and regular technical discussions.


You will have access to approved AI tools to support development, learning and exploration. We encourage you to think carefully about what can be delegated to AI, where human judgement is needed and how to verify the results. You remain responsible for understanding and testing what you deliver.

**About You**
-------------

  

You approach problems with curiosity and initiative. You want to understand why something is needed and are willing to investigate, ask questions and suggest options when requirements leave room for interpretation. You can move work forward independently while recognising when to seek guidance or validate an assumption.


You listen actively and take other people’s perspectives seriously. You bring humility to technical discussions, feel comfortable acknowledging what you do not know and can change your mind when new information reveals a better approach. You communicate progress and difficulties openly, and enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues.


You have hands\-on experience building applications with C\# and .NET. You are familiar with web interfaces, APIs, SQL and application databases, Git, testing and debugging, and care about building software that is secure, maintainable and reliable.


Hands\-on Azure experience is required. Familiarity with a modern frontend framework, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices would be useful.


We welcome earlier\-career candidates who meet the core C\#, .NET and Azure requirements and demonstrate sound foundations, thoughtful problem\-solving and a willingness to learn. You do not need to know every technology on day one. We want to understand how you think, work with others and develop your skills.


English is required. French and German are welcome advantages, but neither is required.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

  

Within your first year, you will have contributed useful and reliable features to our operational products and developed a strong understanding of the workflows they support. Your work will help users complete tasks more easily, understand operational issues and make better\-informed decisions.


You will have contributed to both user\-facing applications and the shared foundations behind them. You will identify gaps before they become problems, explain your technical choices and help the team find solutions that make sense across the wider system.


You will grow into greater technical ownership at a pace suited to your experience, contribute constructively to team discussions and build trust through dependable delivery, curiosity and collaboration.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

  

We take onboarding seriously. We will spend time introducing you to the business, the products and the people you will work with. You will learn how the team operates, who to speak with and where to find support, allowing you to build context and confidence as you take on greater responsibility.


You will join colleagues who make time to explain, discuss difficult problems and share feedback respectfully. There is room to contribute ideas, ask questions, experiment and learn from one another.


This is a permanent position where you can work on applications used in everyday transport operations, connected vehicle data and technical foundations that support several products. You will see how your work affects people’s time, the quality of their decisions and the reliability of the services they provide.


If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving problems across systems and building useful products with people who care about the outcome, we would be happy to meet you.
